1444|### 5.3 工具加载器
1445|
1446|```python
1447|# backend/app/services/tools/loader.py
1448|import importlib
1449|import pkgutil
1450|import sys
1451|from pathlib import Path
1452|from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Set
1453|import yaml
1454|from .registry import ToolRegistry, ToolMetadata
1455|from .types import ToolType, ToolCapability, ToolPermission, ToolRequirements
1456|
1457|class ToolLoader:
1458|    """工具加载器 - 支持动态发现和加载工具"""
1459|    
1460|    def __init__(self, registry: ToolRegistry, config_path: Optional[str] = None):
1461|        self.registry = registry
1462|        self.config_path = config_path or "config/tools_config.yaml"
1463|        self.loaded_modules: Set[str] = set()
1464|        self.failed_modules: Dict[str, str] = {}
1465|        self._load_config()
1466|    
1467|    def _load_config(self) -> None:
1468|        """加载配置"""
1469|        config_file = Path(self.config_path)
1470|        if not config_file.exists():
1471|            self.config = {
1472|                "auto_discover": True,
1473|                "scan_paths": ["app/services/tools"],
1474|                "exclude_patterns": ["**/test_*.py", "**/*_test.py", "**/__pycache__/**"],
1475|                "preload_tools": [],
1476|                "disabled_tools": []
1477|            }
1478|            return
1479|        
1480|        with open(config_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
1481|            self.config = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
1482|    
1483|    def discover_tool_modules(self) -> List[str]:
1484|        """发现所有工具模块"""
1485|        if not self.config.get("auto_discover", True):
1486|            return []
1487|        
1488|        tool_modules = []
1489|        scan_paths = self.config.get("scan_paths", ["app/services/tools"])
1490|        exclude_patterns = self.config.get("exclude_patterns", [])
1491|        
1492|        for scan_path in scan_paths:
1493|            scan_dir = Path(scan_path)
1494|            if not scan_dir.exists():
1495|                continue
1496|            
1497|            # 递归查找Python文件
1498|            for py_file in scan_dir.rglob("*.py"):
1499|                # 检查是否在排除模式中
1500|                file_path = str(py_file)
1501|                if any(self._match_pattern(file_path, pattern) for pattern in exclude_patterns):
1502|                    continue
1503|                
1504|                # 转换为模块路径
1505|                try:
1506|                    module_path = self._file_to_module_path(py_file, scan_dir)
1507|                    if module_path and module_path not in self.loaded_modules:
1508|                        tool_modules.append(module_path)
1509|                except ValueError as e:
1510|                    print(f"无法转换文件路径: {py_file}, 错误: {e}")
1511|        
1512|        return tool_modules
1513|    
1514|    def _match_pattern(self, file_path: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
1515|        """检查文件路径是否匹配模式"""
1516|        from fnmatch import fnmatch
1517|        
1518|        # 将**/*.py模式转换为fnmatch可识别的模式
1519|        if pattern.startswith("**/"):
1520|            # **/test_*.py -> */test_*.py
1521|            pattern = pattern[3:]
1522|        
1523|        return fnmatch(file_path, pattern)
1524|    
1525|    def _file_to_module_path(self, file_path: Path, base_dir: Path) -> str:
1526|        """将文件路径转换为模块路径"""
1527|        # 计算相对路径
1528|        try:
1529|            rel_path = file_path.relative_to(base_dir)
1530|        except ValueError:
1531|            # 文件不在基础目录下
1532|            raise ValueError(f"文件不在基础目录下: {file_path}")
1533|        
1534|        # 转换为模块路径
1535|        module_parts = []
1536|        for part in rel_path.parts:
1537|            if part.endswith(".py"):
1538|                module_parts.append(part[:-3])  # 移除.py
1539|            else:
1540|                module_parts.append(part)
1541|        
1542|        # 构建完整模块路径
1543|        base_module = str(base_dir).replace("/", ".").replace("\\", ".")
1544|        module_path = f"{base_module}.{'.'.join(module_parts)}"
1545|        
1546|        return module_path
1547|    
1548|    def load_tool_module(self, module_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1549|        """加载工具模块"""
1550|        result = {
1551|            "module": module_path,
1552|            "loaded": False,
1553|            "tools": [],
1554|            "errors": []
1555|        }
1556|        
1557|        try:
1558|            # 导入模块
1559|            module = importlib.import_module(module_path)
1560|            
1561|            # 查找模块中的所有工具函数
1562|            tools_found = []
1563|            for attr_name in dir(module):
1564|                attr = getattr(module, attr_name)
1565|                
1566|                # 检查是否被@tool装饰
1567|                if hasattr(attr, '__tool_metadata__'):
1568|                    metadata = getattr(attr, '__tool_metadata__')
1569|                    tools_found.append({
1570|                        "name": metadata.name,
1571|                        "display_name": metadata.display_name,
1572|                        "type": metadata.type.value,
1573|                        "function": attr_name
1574|                    })
1575|            
1576|            if tools_found:
1577|                result["loaded"] = True
1578|                result["tools"] = tools_found
1579|                self.loaded_modules.add(module_path)
1580|                print(f"成功加载模块: {module_path}, 找到 {len(tools_found)} 个工具")
1581|            else:
1582|                result["errors"].append(f"模块中未找到工具: {module_path}")
1583|                
1584|        except ImportError as e:
1585|            result["errors"].append(f"导入模块失败: {e}")
1586|            self.failed_modules[module_path] = str(e)
1587|        except Exception as e:
1588|            result["errors"].append(f"加载模块时出错: {e}")
1589|            self.failed_modules[module_path] = str(e)
1590|        
1591|        return result
1592|    
1593|    def load_all_tools(self) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
1594|        """加载所有工具"""
1595|        results = {
1596|            "loaded": [],
1597|            "failed": [],
1598|            "skipped": []
1599|        }
1600|        
1601|        # 预加载工具
1602|        preload_tools = self.config.get("preload_tools", [])
1603|        for tool_config in preload_tools:
1604|            try:
1605|                self._load_predefined_tool(tool_config)
1606|                results["loaded"].append(f"预加载工具: {tool_config.get('name', 'unknown')}")
1607|            except Exception as e:
1608|                results["failed"].append(f"预加载工具失败: {tool_config.get('name', 'unknown')}: {e}")
1609|        
1610|        # 自动发现和加载
1611|        if self.config.get("auto_discover", True):
1612|            tool_modules = self.discover_tool_modules()
1613|            
1614|            for module_path in tool_modules:
1615|                if module_path in self.loaded_modules:
1616|                    results["skipped"].append(f"模块已加载: {module_path}")
1617|                    continue
1618|                
1619|                load_result = self.load_tool_module(module_path)
1620|                if load_result["loaded"]:
1621|                    results["loaded"].append(f"模块: {module_path}")
1622|                    results["loaded"].extend([
1623|                        f"  - {tool['name']} ({tool['type']})"
1624|                        for tool in load_result["tools"]
1625|                    ])
1626|                else:
1627|                    results["failed"].append(f"模块: {module_path}")
1628|                    results["failed"].extend([
1629|                        f"  - 错误: {error}"
1630|                        for error in load_result["errors"]
1631|                    ])
1632|        
1633|        return results
1634|    
1635|    def _load_predefined_tool(self, config: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1636|        """加载预定义工具"""
1637|        # 创建工具元数据
1638|        metadata = ToolMetadata(
1639|            name=config["name"],
1640|            display_name=config.get("display_name", config["name"]),
1641|            description=config.get("description", ""),
1642|            type=ToolType(config.get("type", "custom")),
1643|            category=config.get("category", "general"),
1644|            version=config.get("version", "1.0.0"),
1645|            author=config.get("author", ""),
1646|            capabilities=[ToolCapability(c) for c in config.get("capabilities", [])],
1647|            permissions=[ToolPermission(p) for p in config.get("permissions", [])],
1648|            requirements=ToolRequirements(**config.get("requirements", {})),
1649|            input_schema=config.get("input_schema", {}),
1650|            output_schema=config.get("output_schema", {}),
1651|            examples=config.get("examples", []),
1652|            dependencies=config.get("dependencies", []),
1653|            tags=config.get("tags", []),
1654|            enabled=config.get("enabled", True)
1655|        )
1656|        
1657|        # 创建工具函数
1658|        def tool_function(**kwargs):
1659|            # 这里可以调用实际的工具实现
1660|            # 对于预定义工具，可能需要从配置中加载实现
1661|            implementation = config.get("implementation")
1662|            if implementation:
1663|                # 动态加载实现
1664|                module_name, func_name = implementation.rsplit(".", 1)
1665|                module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
1666|                func = getattr(module, func_name)
1667|                return func(**kwargs)
1668|            else:
1669|                # 返回模拟结果
1670|                return {
1671|                    "status": "success",
1672|                    "message": f"预定义工具 '{config['name']}' 执行成功",
1673|                    "data": kwargs
1674|                }
1675|        
1676|        # 添加元数据到函数
1677|        tool_function.__tool_metadata__ = metadata
1678|        
1679|        # 注册工具
1680|        self.registry.register(metadata)
1681|    
1682|    def reload(self) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
1683|        """重新加载所有工具"""
1684|        # 清空已加载模块
1685|        self.loaded_modules.clear()
1686|        self.failed_modules.clear()
1687|        
1688|        # 重新加载配置
1689|        self._load_config()
1690|        
1691|        # 重新加载所有工具
1692|        return self.load_all_tools()
1693|    
1694|    def get_loaded_modules(self) -> List[str]:
1695|        """获取已加载的模块"""
1696|        return list(self.loaded_modules)
1697|    
1698|    def get_failed_modules(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
1699|        """获取加载失败的模块"""
1700|        return self.failed_modules.copy()
1701|```

1703|### 5.4 工具管理器
1704|
1705|```python
1706|# backend/app/services/tools/manager.py
1707|import asyncio
1708|import json
1709|from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional, Set, Union
1710|from datetime import datetime, timedelta
1711|from dataclasses import asdict
1712|import threading
1713|import time
1714|from .registry import ToolRegistry, ToolMetadata
1715|from .loader import ToolLoader
1716|from .types import ToolType, ToolCapability
1717|
1718|class ToolManager:
1719|    """工具管理器 - 统一管理工具的生命周期"""
1720|    
1721|    def __init__(
1722|        self,
1723|        registry: Optional[ToolRegistry] = None,
1724|        loader: Optional[ToolLoader] = None,
1725|        config_path: Optional[str] = None
1726|    ):
1727|        self.registry = registry or ToolRegistry()
1728|        self.loader = loader or ToolLoader(self.registry, config_path)
1729|        self._initialized = False
1730|        self._lock = threading.RLock()
1731|        self._health_check_interval = 60  # 健康检查间隔（秒）
1732|        self._last_health_check = None
1733|        
1734|        # 工具健康状态
1735|        self._tool_health: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
1736|        
1737|        # 工具使用统计
1738|        self._tool_stats: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
1739|        
1740|        # 工具依赖图
1741|        self._dependency_graph: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {}
1742|        
1743|        # 事件监听器
1744|        self._event_listeners: Dict[str, List[callable]] = {
1745|            "tool_registered": [],
1746|            "tool_unregistered": [],
1747|            "tool_enabled": [],
1748|            "tool_disabled": [],
1749|            "tool_executed": [],
1750|            "tool_failed": []
1751|        }
1752|    
1753|    async def initialize(self) -> None:
1754|        """初始化工具管理器"""
1755|        with self._lock:
1756|            if self._initialized:
1757|                return
1758|            
1759|            print("正在初始化工具管理器...")
1760|            
1761|            # 加载所有工具
1762|            load_results = self.loader.load_all_tools()
1763|            
1764|            # 构建依赖图
1765|            self._build_dependency_graph()
1766|            
1767|            # 初始化健康状态
1768|            self._initialize_health_status()
1769|            
1770|            # 初始化使用统计
1771|            self._initialize_stats()
1772|            
1773|            # 启动健康检查任务
1774|            asyncio.create_task(self._health_check_task())
1775|            
1776|            self._initialized = True
1777|            
1778|            print(f"工具管理器初始化完成。加载结果: {json.dumps(load_results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}")
1779|    
1780|    def _build_dependency_graph(self) -> None:
1781|        """构建工具依赖图"""
1782|        self._dependency_graph.clear()
1783|        
1784|        # 添加所有工具节点
1785|        for tool_id, tool in self.registry._tools.items():
1786|            self._dependency_graph[tool_id] = set(tool.dependencies)
1787|    
1788|    def _initialize_health_status(self) -> None:
1789|        """初始化工具健康状态"""
1790|        for tool_id in self.registry._tools.keys():
1791|            self._tool_health[tool_id] = {
1792|                "status": "healthy",
1793|                "last_check": datetime.now().isoformat(),
1794|                "error_count": 0,
1795|                "consecutive_errors": 0,
1796|                "last_error": None,
1797|                "last_success": None
1798|            }
1799|    
1800|    def _initialize_stats(self) -> None:
1801|        """初始化工具使用统计"""
1802|        for tool_id in self.registry._tools.keys():
1803|            self._tool_stats[tool_id] = {
1804|                "total_executions": 0,
1805|                "successful_executions": 0,
1806|                "failed_executions": 0,
1807|                "total_execution_time": 0.0,
1808|                "avg_execution_time": 0.0,
1809|                "last_execution": None,
1810|                "concurrent_executions": 0,
1811|                "max_concurrent_executions": 0
1812|            }
1813|    
1814|    async def _health_check_task(self) -> None:
1815|        """健康检查任务"""
1816|        while True:
1817|            try:
1818|                await self._perform_health_check()
1819|            except Exception as e:
1820|                print(f"健康检查任务出错: {e}")
1821|            
1822|            await asyncio.sleep(self._health_check_interval)
1823|    
1824|    async def _perform_health_check(self) -> None:
1825|        """执行健康检查"""
1826|        with self._lock:
1827|            self._last_health_check = datetime.now()
1828|            
1829|            for tool_id, tool in self.registry._tools.items():
1830|                if not tool.enabled:
1831|                    continue
1832|                
1833|                try:
1834|                    # 检查工具依赖是否可用
1835|                    missing_deps = self._check_dependencies(tool_id)
1836|                    if missing_deps:
1837|                        self._update_health_status(
1838|                            tool_id,
1839|                            "unhealthy",
1840|                            f"缺少依赖: {', '.join(missing_deps)}"
1841|                        )
1842|                        continue
1843|                    
1844|                    # 检查工具资源要求
1845|                    if not self._check_resource_requirements(tool):
1846|                        self._update_health_status(
1847|                            tool_id,
1848|                            "unhealthy",
1849|                            "资源要求不满足"
1850|                        )
1851|                        continue
1852|                    
1853|                    # 执行健康检查（如果有）
1854|                    if hasattr(tool, 'health_check'):
1855|                        health_result = await tool.health_check()
1856|                        if not health_result.get("healthy", True):
1857|                            self._update_health_status(
1858|                                tool_id,
1859|                                "unhealthy",
1860|                                health_result.get("message", "健康检查失败")
1861|                            )
1862|                            continue
1863|                    
1864|                    # 工具健康
1865|                    self._update_health_status(tool_id, "healthy")
1866|                    
1867|                except Exception as e:
1868|                    self._update_health_status(
1869|                        tool_id,
1870|                        "unhealthy",
1871|                        f"健康检查异常: {str(e)}"
1872|                    )
1873|    
1874|    def _check_dependencies(self, tool_id: str) -> List[str]:
1875|        """检查工具依赖"""
1876|        missing = []
1877|        dependencies = self._dependency_graph.get(tool_id, set())
1878|        
1879|        for dep_id in dependencies:
1880|            dep_tool = self.registry.get_tool(dep_id)
1881|            if not dep_tool or not dep_tool.enabled:
1882|                missing.append(dep_id)

1894|    def _update_health_status(
1895|        self,

1904|        health["status"] = status
1905|        health["last_check"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
1906|        
1907|        if status == "healthy":
1908|            health["consecutive_errors"] = 0
1909|            health["last_success"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
1910|        else:
1911|            health["error_count"] = health.get("error_count", 0) + 1
1912|            health["consecutive_errors"] = health.get("consecutive_errors", 0) + 1
1913|            health["last_error"] = message or "未知错误"
1914|        
1915|        self._tool_health[tool_id] = health
1916|

1920|                "tool_id": tool_id,
1921|                "old_status": old_status,

1927|    def record_tool_execution(
1928|        self,
1929|        tool_id: str,
1930|        success: bool,
1931|        execution_time: float,
1932|        error: Optional[str] = None
1933|    ) -> None:

1935|        with self._lock:

1940|            stats["total_execution_time"] = stats.get("total_execution_time", 0.0) + execution_time
1941|            stats["avg_execution_time"] = stats["total_execution_time"] / stats["total_executions"]
1942|            stats["last_execution"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
1943|            
1944|            if success:
1945|                stats["successful_executions"] = stats.get("successful_executions", 0) + 1
1946|            else:
1947|                stats["failed_executions"] = stats.get("failed_executions", 0) + 1
1948|            
1949|            # 更新并发执行数
1950|            stats["concurrent_executions"] = stats.get("concurrent_executions", 0) + 1
1951|            stats["max_concurrent_executions"] = max(
1952|                stats.get("max_concurrent_executions", 0),
1953|                stats["concurrent_executions"]
1954|            )
1955|            
1956|            self._tool_stats[tool_id] = stats
1957|            
1958|            # 触发事件
1959|            event_type = "tool_executed" if success else "tool_failed"
1960|            self._trigger_event(event_type, {
1961|                "tool_id": tool_id,
1962|                "success": success,
1963|                "execution_time": execution_time,
1964|                "error": error,
1965|                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
1966|            })

1968|    def finish_tool_execution(self, tool_id: str) -> None:

1972|            current = stats.get("concurrent_executions", 0)
1973|            if current > 0:
1974|                stats["concurrent_executions"] = current - 1
1975|                self._tool_stats[tool_id] = stats

2024|            if not tool:

2026|            
2027|            if not tool.enabled:

2029|            
2030|            tool.enabled = False

2042|    def add_event_listener(self, event_type: str, listener: callable) -> None:
2043|        """添加事件监听器"""
2044|        with self._lock:
2045|            if event_type not in self._event_listeners:
2046|                self._event_listeners[event_type] = []
2047|            self._event_listeners[event_type].append(listener)
2048|    
2049|    def remove_event_listener(self, event_type: str, listener: callable) -> None:
2050|        """移除事件监听器"""
2051|        with self._lock:
2052|            if event_type in self._event_listeners and listener in self._event_listeners[event_type]:
2053|                self._event_listeners[event_type].remove(listener)
2054|    
2055|    def _trigger_event(self, event_type: str, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
2056|        """触发事件"""
2057|        listeners = self._event_listeners.get(event_type, [])
2058|        for listener in listeners:
2059|            try:
2060|                listener(event_type, data)
2061|            except Exception as e:
2062|                print(f"事件监听器错误 ({event_type}): {e}")
2063|    
2064|    def get_dependency_tree(self, tool_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2065|        """获取工具依赖树"""
2066|        def build_tree(current_id: str, visited: Set[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2067|            if visited is None:
2068|                visited = set()
2069|            
2070|            if current_id in visited:
2071|                return {"id": current_id, "circular": True}
2072|            
2073|            visited.add(current_id)
2074|            
2075|            tool = self.registry.get_tool(current_id)
2076|            if not tool:
2077|                return {"id": current_id, "error": "工具不存在"}
2078|            
2079|            node = {
2080|                "id": current_id,
2081|                "name": tool.name,
2082|                "display_name": tool.display_name,
2083|                "type": tool.type.value,
2084|                "enabled": tool.enabled,
2085|                "dependencies": []
2086|            }
2087|            
2088|            for dep_id in tool.dependencies:
2089|                dep_node = build_tree(dep_id, visited.copy())
2090|                node["dependencies"].append(dep_node)
2091|            
2092|            return node
2093|        
2094|        return build_tree(tool_id)
2095|    
2096|    def validate_tool_chain(self, tool_ids: List[str]) -> List[str]:
2097|        """验证工具链"""
2098|        errors = []
2099|        visited = set()
2100|        
2101|        for tool_id in tool_ids:
2102|            if tool_id in visited:
2103|                errors.append(f"工具重复: {tool_id}")
2104|                continue
2105|            
2106|            tool = self.registry.get_tool(tool_id)
2107|            if not tool:
2108|                errors.append(f"工具不存在: {tool_id}")
2109|                continue
2110|            
2111|            if not tool.enabled:
2112|                errors.append(f"工具未启用: {tool_id}")
2113|                continue
2114|            
2115|            # 检查依赖
2116|            missing_deps = self._check_dependencies(tool_id)
2117|            if missing_deps:
2118|                errors.append(f"工具 {tool_id} 缺少依赖: {', '.join(missing_deps)}")
2119|            
2120|            visited.add(tool_id)
2121|        
2122|        return errors

2171|### 6.1 工具链设计
2172|
2173|```python
2174|# backend/app/services/tools/composition.py
2175|from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional, Union, Callable
2176|from dataclasses import dataclass, field
2177|from datetime import datetime
2178|import asyncio
2179|import json
2180|import yaml
2181|from enum import Enum

2183|
2184|class ChainStatus(str, Enum):
2185|    """工具链状态"""
2186|    PENDING = "pending"      # 等待执行
2187|    RUNNING = "running"      # 执行中
2188|    COMPLETED = "completed"  # 已完成
2189|    FAILED = "failed"        # 失败
2190|    CANCELLED = "cancelled"  # 已取消
2191|
2192|class StepStatus(str, Enum):
2193|    """步骤状态"""
2194|    PENDING = "pending"      # 等待执行
2195|    RUNNING = "running"      # 执行中
2196|    SUCCESS = "success"      # 成功
2197|    FAILED = "failed"        # 失败
2198|    SKIPPED = "skipped"      # 跳过
2199|    CANCELLED = "cancelled"  # 已取消
2200|
2201|@dataclass
2202|class StepResult:
2203|    """步骤执行结果"""
2204|    step_id: str
2205|    status: StepStatus
2206|    output: Optional[Any] = None
2207|    error: Optional[str] = None
2208|    execution_time: float = 0.0
2209|    started_at: Optional[datetime] = None
2210|    completed_at: Optional[datetime] = None
2211|    
2212|    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2213|        """转换为字典"""
2214|        return {
2215|            "step_id": self.step_id,
2216|            "status": self.status.value,
2217|            "output": self.output,
2218|            "error": self.error,
2219|            "execution_time": self.execution_time,
2220|            "started_at": self.started_at.isoformat() if self.started_at else None,
2221|            "completed_at": self.completed_at.isoformat() if self.completed_at else None
2222|        }
2223|
2224|@dataclass
2225|class ChainResult:
2226|    """工具链执行结果"""
2227|    chain_id: str
2228|    status: ChainStatus
2229|    steps: Dict[str, StepResult]
2230|    output: Optional[Any] = None
2231|    error: Optional[str] = None
2232|    total_execution_time: float = 0.0
2233|    started_at: Optional[datetime] = None
2234|    completed_at: Optional[datetime] = None
2235|    
2236|    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2237|        """转换为字典"""
2238|        return {
2239|            "chain_id": self.chain_id,
2240|            "status": self.status.value,
2241|            "steps": {step_id: step.to_dict() for step_id, step in self.steps.items()},
2242|            "output": self.output,
2243|            "error": self.error,
2244|            "total_execution_time": self.total_execution_time,
2245|            "started_at": self.started_at.isoformat() if self.started_at else None,
2246|            "completed_at": self.completed_at.isoformat() if self.completed_at else None
2247|        }
2248|
2249|class StepDefinition(BaseModel):
2250|    """步骤定义"""
2251|    id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)
2252|    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200)
2253|    description: Optional[str] = None
2254|    tool: str = Field(..., min_length=1)  # 工具ID
2255|    params: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
2256|    depends_on: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)  # 依赖的步骤ID
2257|    condition: Optional[str] = None  # 执行条件（Python表达式）
2258|    retry_policy: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=lambda: {
2259|        "max_retries": 3,
2260|        "backoff_factor": 2.0,
2261|        "retryable_errors": ["timeout", "network_error"]
2262|    })
2263|    timeout: Optional[int] = None  # 超时时间（秒）
2264|    continue_on_error: bool = False  # 错误时是否继续
2265|    
2266|    @validator("id")
2267|    def validate_id(cls, v):
2268|        if not v.isidentifier():
2269|            raise ValueError(f"步骤ID必须是有效的标识符: {v}")
2270|        return v
2271|    
2272|    @validator("depends_on")
2273|    def validate_dependencies(cls, v, values):
2274|        step_id = values.get("id")
2275|        if step_id in v:
2276|            raise ValueError(f"步骤不能依赖自身: {step_id}")
2277|        return v
2278|
2279|class ChainDefinition(BaseModel):
2280|    """工具链定义"""
2281|    id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)
2282|    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200)
2283|    description: Optional[str] = None
2284|    version: str = Field("1.0.0", regex=r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$")
2285|    steps: List[StepDefinition] = Field(..., min_items=1)
2286|    input_schema: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
2287|    output_schema: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
2288|    max_execution_time: Optional[int] = None  # 最大执行时间（秒）
2289|    concurrent_execution: bool = False  # 是否允许并发执行
2290|    
2291|    @validator("id")
2292|    def validate_id(cls, v):
2293|        if not v.isidentifier():
2294|            raise ValueError(f"工具链ID必须是有效的标识符: {v}")
2295|        return v
2296|    
2297|    @validator("steps")
2298|    def validate_steps(cls, v):
2299|        # 检查步骤ID唯一性
2300|        step_ids = [step.id for step in v]
2301|        if len(step_ids) != len(set(step_ids)):
2302|            raise ValueError("步骤ID必须唯一")
2303|        
2304|        # 检查依赖关系（不能有循环依赖）
2305|        graph = {step.id: set(step.depends_on) for step in v}
2306|        if has_cycle(graph):
2307|            raise ValueError("步骤依赖关系存在循环")
2308|        
2309|        return v
2310|
2311|def has_cycle(graph: Dict[str, Set[str]]) -> bool:
2312|    """检查图中是否有环"""
2313|    visited = set()
2314|    recursion_stack = set()
2315|    
2316|    def dfs(node: str) -> bool:
2317|        if node in recursion_stack:
2318|            return True
2319|        if node in visited:
2320|            return False
2321|        
2322|        visited.add(node)
2323|        recursion_stack.add(node)
2324|        
2325|        for neighbor in graph.get(node, set()):
2326|            if dfs(neighbor):
2327|                return True
2328|        
2329|        recursion_stack.remove(node)
2330|        return False
2331|    
2332|    for node in graph:
2333|        if dfs(node):
2334|            return True
2335|    
2336|    return False
2337|
2338|class ToolChainExecutor:
2339|    """工具链执行器"""
2340|    
2341|    def __init__(self, tool_manager, registry):
2342|        self.tool_manager = tool_manager
2343|        self.registry = registry
2344|        self.running_chains: Dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
2345|        self.chain_results: Dict[str, ChainResult] = {}
2346|        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
2347|    
2348|    async def execute_chain(
2349|        self,
2350|        chain_def: ChainDefinition,
2351|        inputs: Dict[str, Any],
2352|        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
2353|    ) -> ChainResult:
2354|        """执行工具链"""
2355|        chain_id = f"{chain_def.id}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
2356|        
2357|        # 创建执行任务
2358|        task = asyncio.create_task(
2359|            self._execute_chain_internal(chain_id, chain_def, inputs, context or {})
2360|        )
2361|        
2362|        # 保存运行状态
2363|        async with self._lock:
2364|            self.running_chains[chain_id] = task
2365|        
2366|        try:
2367|            # 等待任务完成
2368|            result = await task
2369|            return result
2370|        finally:
2371|            # 清理运行状态
2372|            async with self._lock:
2373|                if chain_id in self.running_chains:
2374|                    del self.running_chains[chain_id]
2375|    
2376|    async def _execute_chain_internal(
2377|        self,
2378|        chain_id: str,
2379|        chain_def: ChainDefinition,
2380|        inputs: Dict[str, Any],
2381|        context: Dict[str, Any]
2382|    ) -> ChainResult:
2383|        """内部执行工具链"""
2384|        start_time = datetime.now()
2385|        
2386|        # 初始化结果
2387|        chain_result = ChainResult(
2388|            chain_id=chain_id,
2389|            status=ChainStatus.RUNNING,
2390|            steps={},
2391|            started_at=start_time
2392|        )
2393|        
2394|        try:
2395|            # 验证输入
2396|            validation_errors = self._validate_inputs(inputs, chain_def.input_schema)
2397|            if validation_errors:
2398|                chain_result.status = ChainStatus.FAILED
2399|                chain_result.error = f"输入验证失败: {', '.join(validation_errors)}"
2400|                chain_result.completed_at = datetime.now()
2401|                chain_result.total_execution_time = (
2402|                    chain_result.completed_at - start_time
2403|                ).total_seconds()
2404|                return chain_result
2405|            
2406|            # 拓扑排序步骤
2407|            sorted_steps = self._topological_sort(chain_def.steps)
2408|            
2409|            # 执行上下文
2410|            execution_context = {
2411|                "inputs": inputs,
2412|                "context": context,
2413|                "results": {},
2414|                "variables": {}
2415|            }
2416|            
2417|            # 执行步骤
2418|            step_results = {}
2419|            for step in sorted_steps:
2420|                step_result = await self._execute_step(
2421|                    step, chain_def, execution_context, chain_id
2422|                )
2423|                step_results[step.id] = step_result
2424|                
2425|                # 更新执行上下文
2426|                execution_context["results"][step.id] = step_result
2427|                if step_result.output is not None:
2428|                    execution_context["variables"][step.id] = step_result.output
2429|                
2430|                # 检查步骤结果
2431|                if step_result.status == StepStatus.FAILED and not step.continue_on_error:
2432|                    chain_result.status = ChainStatus.FAILED
2433|                    chain_result.error = f"步骤 '{step.name}' 执行失败: {step_result.error}"
2434|                    break
2435|            
2436|            # 更新链结果
2437|            chain_result.steps = step_results
2438|            
2439|            # 检查最终状态
2440|            if chain_result.status == ChainStatus.RUNNING:
2441|                # 所有步骤执行完成
2442|                chain_result.status = ChainStatus.COMPLETED
2443|                
2444|                # 生成输出
2445|                chain_result.output = self._generate_output(
2446|                    chain_def, execution_context
2447|                )
2448|            
2449|        except asyncio.CancelledError:
2450|            chain_result.status = ChainStatus.CANCELLED
2451|            chain_result.error = "工具链执行被取消"
2452|        except Exception as e:
2453|            chain_result.status = ChainStatus.FAILED
2454|            chain_result.error = f"工具链执行异常: {str(e)}"
2455|        finally:
2456|            # 计算执行时间
2457|            end_time = datetime.now()
2458|            chain_result.completed_at = end_time
2459|            chain_result.total_execution_time = (end_time - start_time).total_seconds()
2460|            
2461|            # 保存结果
2462|            async with self._lock:
2463|                self.chain_results[chain_id] = chain_result
2464|        
2465|        return chain_result
2466|    
2467|    def _validate_inputs(
2468|        self,
2469|        inputs: Dict[str, Any],
2470|        input_schema: Dict[str, Any]
2471|    ) -> List[str]:
2472|        """验证输入数据"""
2473|        errors = []
2474|        
2475|        # 检查必需字段
2476|        required_fields = input_schema.get("required", [])
2477|        for field in required_fields:
2478|            if field not in inputs:
2479|                errors.append(f"缺少必需字段: {field}")
2480|        
2481|        # 检查字段类型（简化验证）
2482|        properties = input_schema.get("properties", {})
2483|        for field, value in inputs.items():
2484|            if field in properties:
2485|                field_schema = properties[field]
2486|                field_type = field_schema.get("type")
2487|                
2488|                if field_type == "string" and not isinstance(value, str):
2489|                    errors.append(f"字段 '{field}' 应该是字符串类型")
2490|                elif field_type == "integer" and not isinstance(value, int):
2491|                    errors.append(f"字段 '{field}' 应该是整数类型")
2492|                elif field_type == "number" and not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
2493|                    errors.append(f"字段 '{field}' 应该是数字类型")
2494|                elif field_type == "boolean" and not isinstance(value, bool):
2495|                    errors.append(f"字段 '{field}' 应该是布尔类型")
2496|                elif field_type == "array" and not isinstance(value, list):
2497|                    errors.append(f"字段 '{field}' 应该是数组类型")
2498|                elif field_type == "object" and not isinstance(value, dict):
2499|                    errors.append(f"字段 '{field}' 应该是对象类型")
2500|        
2501|        return errors
2502|    
2503|    def _topological_sort(self, steps: List[StepDefinition]) -> List[StepDefinition]:
2504|        """拓扑排序步骤"""
2505|        # 构建图
2506|        graph = {step.id: step for step in steps}
2507|        dependencies = {step.id: set(step.depends_on) for step in steps}
2508|        
2509|        # Kahn算法进行拓扑排序
2510|        in_degree = {step.id: 0 for step in steps}
2511|        for step in steps:
2512|            for dep in step.depends_on:
2513|                if dep in in_degree:
2514|                    in_degree[dep] += 1
2515|        
2516|        # 找到入度为0的节点
2517|        queue = [step_id for step_id, degree in in_degree.items() if degree == 0]
2518|        sorted_steps = []
2519|        
2520|        while queue:
2521|            step_id = queue.pop(0)
2522|            sorted_steps.append(graph[step_id])
2523|            
2524|            # 减少依赖节点的入度
2525|            for step in steps:
2526|                if step_id in step.depends_on:
2527|                    in_degree[step.id] -= 1
2528|                    if in_degree[step.id] == 0:
2529|                        queue.append(step.id)
2530|        
2531|        # 检查是否有环
2532|        if len(sorted_steps) != len(steps):
2533|            raise ValueError("步骤依赖关系存在循环")
2534|        
2535|        return sorted_steps
2536|    
2537|    async def _execute_step(
2538|        self,
2539|        step: StepDefinition,
2540|        chain_def: ChainDefinition,
2541|        context: Dict[str, Any],
2542|        chain_id: str
2543|    ) -> StepResult:
2544|        """执行单个步骤"""
2545|        start_time = datetime.now()
2546|        step_result = StepResult(
2547|            step_id=step.id,
2548|            status=StepStatus.PENDING,
2549|            started_at=start_time
2550|        )
2551|        
2552|        try:
2553|            # 检查执行条件
2554|            if step.condition:
2555|                if not self._evaluate_condition(step.condition, context):
2556|                    step_result.status = StepStatus.SKIPPED
2557|                    step_result.completed_at = datetime.now()
2558|                    step_result.execution_time = (
2559|                        step_result.completed_at - start_time
2560|                    ).total_seconds()
2561|                    return step_result
2562|            
2563|            # 准备参数
2564|            params = self._prepare_step_params(step.params, context)
2565|            
2566|            # 获取工具
2567|            tool = self.registry.get_tool_by_name(step.tool)
2568|            if not tool:
2569|                step_result.status = StepStatus.FAILED
2570|                step_result.error = f"工具不存在: {step.tool}"
2571|                step_result.completed_at = datetime.now()
2572|                step_result.execution_time = (
2573|                    step_result.completed_at - start_time
2574|                ).total_seconds()
2575|                return step_result
2576|            
2577|            # 检查工具是否启用
2578|            if not tool.enabled:
2579|                step_result.status = StepStatus.FAILED
2580|                step_result.error = f"工具未启用: {step.tool}"
2581|                step_result.completed_at = datetime.now()
2582|                step_result.execution_time = (
2583|                    step_result.completed_at - start_time
2584|                ).total_seconds()
2585|                return step_result
2586|            
2587|            # 执行工具（支持重试）
2588|            step_result.status = StepStatus.RUNNING
2589|            
2590|            max_retries = step.retry_policy.get("max_retries", 3)
2591|            backoff_factor = step.retry_policy.get("backoff_factor", 2.0)
2592|            retryable_errors = step.retry_policy.get("retryable_errors", [])
2593|            timeout = step.timeout or tool.requirements.timeout_seconds
2594|            
2595|            for attempt in range(max_retries + 1):
2596|                try:
2597|                    # 获取工具函数
2598|                    tool_func = self._get_tool_function(step.tool)
2599|                    if not tool_func:
2600|                        raise ValueError(f"无法获取工具函数: {step.tool}")
2601|                    
2602|                    # 设置超时
2603|                    execution_task = asyncio.wait_for(
2604|                        tool_func(**params),
2605|                        timeout=timeout
2606|                    )
2607|                    
2608|                    # 执行工具
2609|                    output = await execution_task
2610|                    
2611|                    # 记录成功
2612|                    step_result.status = StepStatus.SUCCESS
2613|                    step_result.output = output
2614|                    break
2615|                    
2616|                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
2617|                    if attempt == max_retries:
2618|                        step_result.status = StepStatus.FAILED
2619|                        step_result.error = f"执行超时 ({timeout}秒)"
2620|                    else:
2621|                        # 重试
2622|                        wait_time = backoff_factor ** attempt
2623|                        await asyncio.sleep(wait_time)
2624|                        continue
2625|                        
2626|                except Exception as e:
2627|                    error_msg = str(e)
2628|                    
2629|                    # 检查是否可重试的错误
2630|                    is_retryable = any(
2631|                        retryable_error in error_msg.lower()
2632|                        for retryable_error in retryable_errors
2633|                    )
2634|                    
2635|                    if not is_retryable or attempt == max_retries:
2636|                        step_result.status = StepStatus.FAILED
2637|                        step_result.error = error_msg
2638|                        break
2639|                    else:
2640|                        # 重试
2641|                        wait_time = backoff_factor ** attempt
2642|                        await asyncio.sleep(wait_time)
2643|                        continue
2644|            
2645|            # 记录执行时间
2646|            step_result.completed_at = datetime.now()
2647|            step_result.execution_time = (
2648|                step_result.completed_at - start_time
2649|            ).total_seconds()
2650|            
2651|            # 记录工具执行统计
2652|            self.tool_manager.record_tool_execution(
2653|                tool_id=step.tool,
2654|                success=step_result.status == StepStatus.SUCCESS,
2655|                execution_time=step_result.execution_time,
2656|                error=step_result.error
2657|            )
2658|            
2659|        except Exception as e:
2660|            step_result.status = StepStatus.FAILED
2661|            step_result.error = f"步骤执行异常: {str(e)}"
2662|            step_result.completed_at = datetime.now()
2663|            step_result.execution_time = (
2664|                step_result.completed_at - start_time
2665|            ).total_seconds()
2666|        
2667|        return step_result
2668|    
2669|    def _evaluate_condition(self, condition: str, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
2670|        """评估执行条件"""
2671|        try:
2672|            # 安全地评估Python表达式
2673|            # 注意：实际实现中应该使用更安全的表达式评估库
2674|            # 这里使用简单的变量替换
2675|            locals_dict = {
2676|                "inputs": context.get("inputs", {}),
2677|                "results": context.get("results", {}),
2678|                "variables": context.get("variables", {}),
2679|                "context": context.get("context", {})
2680|            }
2681|            
2682|            # 替换变量引用
2683|            # 例如: {{results.step1.output}} -> context["results"]["step1"]["output"]
2684|            import re
2685|            
2686|            def replace_var(match):
2687|                var_path = match.group(1).strip()
2688|                parts = var_path.split(".")
2689|                
2690|                current = locals_dict
2691|                for part in parts:
2692|                    if isinstance(current, dict) and part in current:
2693|                        current = current[part]
2694|                    else:
2695|                        return "None"
2696|                
2697|                return repr(current)
2698|            
2699|            # 替换{{variable}}格式的变量
2700|            condition = re.sub(r"\{\{\s*(.+?)\s*\}\}", replace_var, condition)
2701|            
2702|            # 评估表达式
2703|            result = eval(condition, {"__builtins__": {}}, locals_dict)
2704|            return bool(result)
2705|            
2706|        except Exception as e:
2707|            print(f"条件评估失败: {condition}, 错误: {e}")
2708|            return False
2709|    
2710|    def _prepare_step_params(
2711|        self,
2712|        params: Dict[str, Any],
2713|        context: Dict[str, Any]
2714|    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2715|        """准备步骤参数"""
2716|        prepared_params = {}
2717|        
2718|        for key, value in params.items():
2719|            if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("{{") and value.endswith("}}"):
2720|                # 变量引用
2721|                var_path = value[2:-2].strip()
2722|                prepared_params[key] = self._resolve_variable(var_path, context)
2723|            elif isinstance(value, dict):
2724|                # 递归处理字典
2725|                prepared_params[key] = self._prepare_step_params(value, context)
2726|            elif isinstance(value, list):
2727|                # 递归处理列表
2728|                prepared_params[key] = [
2729|                    self._prepare_step_params(item, context) if isinstance(item, dict) else item
2730|                    for item in value
2731|                ]
2732|            else:
2733|                prepared_params[key] = value
2734|        
2735|        return prepared_params
2736|    
2737|    def _resolve_variable(self, var_path: str, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
2738|        """解析变量路径"""
2739|        parts = var_path.split(".")
2740|        
2741|        current = context
2742|        for part in parts:
2743|            if isinstance(current, dict) and part in current:
2744|                current = current[part]
2745|            else:
2746|                # 尝试从嵌套结构中获取
2747|                try:
2748|                    for sub_part in part.split("["):
2749|                        if "]" in sub_part:
2750|                            # 数组索引
2751|                            idx = int(sub_part.split("]")[0])
2752|                            current = current[idx]
2753|                        else:
2754|                            current = current[sub_part]
2755|                except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError):
2756|                    raise ValueError(f"无法解析变量: {var_path}")
2757|        
2758|        return current
2759|    
2760|    def _get_tool_function(self, tool_name: str) -> Optional[Callable]:
2761|        """获取工具函数"""
2762|        # 这里应该从工具注册表中获取工具函数
2763|        # 简化实现，实际应该从registry中获取
2764|        from .decorators import get_tool_registry
2765|        
2766|        registry = get_tool_registry()
2767|        tool = registry.get_tool_by_name(tool_name)
2768|        if not tool:
2769|            return None
2770|        
2771|        # 在实际实现中，这里应该返回工具的实际函数
2772|        # 这里返回一个模拟函数
2773|        async def mock_tool_function(**kwargs):
2774|            return {"status": "success", "data": kwargs}
2775|        
2776|        return mock_tool_function
2777|    
2778|    def _generate_output(
2779|        self,
2780|        chain_def: ChainDefinition,
2781|        context: Dict[str, Any]
2782|    ) -> Any:
2783|        """生成工具链输出"""
2784|        output_schema = chain_def.output_schema
2785|        
2786|        if not output_schema:
2787|            # 如果没有定义输出schema，返回所有步骤结果
2788|            return {
2789|                step_id: result.output
2790|                for step_id, result in context["results"].items()
2791|                if result.status == StepStatus.SUCCESS
2792|            }
2793|        
2794|        # 根据输出schema生成输出
2795|        output = {}
2796|        for field, field_schema in output_schema.get("properties", {}).items():
2797|            # 从field_schema中获取映射规则
2798|            mapping = field_schema.get("mapping")
2799|            if mapping and isinstance(mapping, str):
2800|                # 解析映射规则
2801|                output[field] = self._resolve_variable(mapping, context)
2802|            else:
2803|                # 默认映射到同名字段
2804|                output[field] = context.get("variables", {}).get(field)
2805|        
2806|        return output
2807|    
2808|    async def cancel_chain(self, chain_id: str) -> bool:
2809|        """取消工具链执行"""
2810|        async with self._lock:
2811|            task = self.running_chains.get(chain_id)
2812|            if task:
2813|                task.cancel()
2814|                return True
2815|            return False
2816|    
2817|    def get_chain_status(self, chain_id: str) -> Optional[ChainResult]:
2818|        """获取工具链状态"""
2819|        # 检查是否正在运行
2820|        async with self._lock:
2821|            if chain_id in self.running_chains:
2822|                return ChainResult(
2823|                    chain_id=chain_id,
2824|                    status=ChainStatus.RUNNING,
2825|                    steps={},
2826|                    started_at=datetime.now()
2827|                )
2828|        
2829|        # 检查是否有结果
2830|        return self.chain_results.get(chain_id)
2831|    
2832|    def list_running_chains(self) -> List[str]:
2833|        """列出正在运行的工具链"""
2834|        return list(self.running_chains.keys())
2835|    
2836|    def list_completed_chains(
2837|        self,
2838|        limit: int = 100,
2839|        offset: int = 0
2840|    ) -> List[ChainResult]:
2841|        """列出已完成的工具链"""
2842|        results = list(self.chain_results.values())
2843|        results.sort(key=lambda x: x.completed_at or datetime.min, reverse=True)
2844|        return results[offset:offset + limit]

2847|### 6.2 工作流引擎设计
2848|
2849|```python
2850|# backend/app/services/tools/workflow.py
2851|from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional, Union, Callable
2852|from dataclasses import dataclass, field
2853|from datetime import datetime
2854|import asyncio
2855|import json
2856|import yaml
2857|from enum import Enum
2858|from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, validator
2859|import networkx as nx
2860|
2861|class WorkflowStatus(str, Enum):
2862|    """工作流状态"""
2863|    DRAFT = "draft"          # 草稿
2864|    ACTIVE = "active"        # 活跃
2865|    PAUSED = "paused"        # 暂停
2866|    DISABLED = "disabled"    # 禁用
2867|
2868|class TriggerType(str, Enum):
2869|    """触发器类型"""
2870|    MANUAL = "manual"        # 手动触发
2871|    SCHEDULE = "schedule"    # 定时触发
2872|    EVENT = "event"          # 事件触发
2873|    WEBHOOK = "webhook"      # Webhook触发
2874|
2875|class ConditionOperator(str, Enum):
2876|    """条件运算符"""
2877|    EQUALS = "equals"        # 等于
2878|    NOT_EQUALS = "not_equals" # 不等于
2879|    GREATER_THAN = "greater_than" # 大于
2880|    LESS_THAN = "less_than"  # 小于
2881|    CONTAINS = "contains"    # 包含
2882|    NOT_CONTAINS = "not_contains" # 不包含
2883|    STARTS_WITH = "starts_with" # 以...开始
2884|    ENDS_WITH = "ends_with"  # 以...结束
2885|    IS_EMPTY = "is_empty"    # 为空
2886|    IS_NOT_EMPTY = "is_not_empty" # 不为空
2887|
2888|@dataclass
2889|class Condition:
2890|    """条件定义"""
2891|    field: str               # 字段名
2892|    operator: ConditionOperator  # 运算符
2893|    value: Any               # 比较值
2894|    
2895|    def evaluate(self, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
2896|        """评估条件"""
2897|        field_value = data.get(self.field)
2898|        
2899|        if self.operator == ConditionOperator.EQUALS:
2900|            return field_value == self.value
2901|        elif self.operator == ConditionOperator.NOT_EQUALS:
2902|            return field_value != self.value
2903|        elif self.operator == ConditionOperator.GREATER_THAN:
2904|            return field_value > self.value
2905|        elif self.operator == ConditionOperator.LESS_THAN:
2906|            return field_value < self.value
2907|        elif self.operator == ConditionOperator.CONTAINS:
2908|            return self.value in field_value if field_value else False
2909|        elif self.operator == ConditionOperator.NOT_CONTAINS:
2910|            return self.value not in field_value if field_value else True
2911|        elif self.operator == ConditionOperator.STARTS_WITH:
2912|            return field_value.startswith(self.value) if field_value else False
2913|        elif self.operator == ConditionOperator.ENDS_WITH:
2914|            return field_value.endswith(self.value) if field_value else False
2915|        elif self.operator == ConditionOperator.IS_EMPTY:
2916|            return not field_value or (isinstance(field_value, str) and not field_value.strip())
2917|        elif self.operator == ConditionOperator.IS_NOT_EMPTY:
2918|            return bool(field_value) and (not isinstance(field_value, str) or field_value.strip())
2919|        else:
2920|            return False
2921|
2922|@dataclass
2923|class Trigger:
2924|    """触发器定义"""
2925|    type: TriggerType
2926|    config: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
2927|    enabled: bool = True
2928|    
2929|    @classmethod
2930|    def manual(cls) -> 'Trigger':
2931|        """手动触发器"""
2932|        return cls(type=TriggerType.MANUAL)
2933|    
2934|    @classmethod
2935|    def schedule(cls, cron_expression: str) -> 'Trigger':
2936|        """定时触发器"""
2937|        return cls(
2938|            type=TriggerType.SCHEDULE,
2939|            config={"cron": cron_expression}
2940|        )
2941|    
2942|    @classmethod
2943|    def event(cls, event_type: str, conditions: List[Condition]) -> 'Trigger':
2944|        """事件触发器"""
2945|        return cls(
2946|            type=TriggerType.EVENT,
2947|            config={
2948|                "event_type": event_type,
2949|                "conditions": conditions
2950|            }
2951|        )
2952|    
2953|    @classmethod
2954|    def webhook(cls, path: str, methods: List[str] = None) -> 'Trigger':
2955|        """Webhook触发器"""
2956|        return cls(
2957|            type=TriggerType.WEBHOOK,
2958|            config={
2959|                "path": path,
2960|                "methods": methods or ["POST"]
2961|            }
2962|        )
2963|
2964|@dataclass
2965|class WorkflowStep:
2966|    """工作流步骤"""
2967|    id: str
2968|    name: str
2969|    description: Optional[str] = None
2970|    tool: str  # 工具ID或工具链ID
2971|    params: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
2972|    conditions: List[Condition] = field(default_factory=list)  # 执行条件
2973|    on_success: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # 成功时跳转的步骤
2974|    on_failure: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # 失败时跳转的步骤
2975|    retry_policy: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=lambda: {
2976|        "max_retries": 3,
2977|        "backoff_factor": 2.0
2978|    })
2979|    timeout: Optional[int] = None
2980|    parallel: bool = False  # 是否并行执行
2981|
2982|@dataclass
2983|class WorkflowDefinition:
2984|    """工作流定义"""
2985|    id: str
2986|    name: str
2987|    description: Optional[str] = None
2988|    version: str = "1.0.0"
2989|    status: WorkflowStatus = WorkflowStatus.DRAFT
2990|    triggers: List[Trigger] = field(default_factory=list)
2991|    steps: List[WorkflowStep] = field(default_factory=list)
2992|    variables: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)  # 工作流变量
2993|    input_schema: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
2994|    output_schema: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
2995|    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
2996|    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
2997|    
2998|    def validate(self) -> List[str]:
2999|        """验证工作流定义"""
3000|        errors = []
3001|        
3002|        # 检查ID
3003|        if not self.id or not self.id.strip():
3004|            errors.append("工作流ID不能为空")
3005|        
3006|        # 检查名称
3007|        if not self.name or not self.name.strip():
3008|            errors.append("工作流名称不能为空")
3009|        
3010|        # 检查步骤
3011|        if not self.steps:
3012|            errors.append("工作流必须包含至少一个步骤")
3013|        
3014|        # 检查步骤ID唯一性
3015|        step_ids = [step.id for step in self.steps]
3016|        if len(step_ids) != len(set(step_ids)):
3017|            errors.append("步骤ID必须唯一")
3018|        
3019|        # 检查跳转目标是否存在
3020|        all_step_ids = set(step_ids)
3021|        for step in self.steps:
3022|            for target_id in step.on_success + step.on_failure:
3023|                if target_id not in all_step_ids:
3024|                    errors.append(f"步骤 '{step.id}' 的跳转目标 '{target_id}' 不存在")
3025|        
3026|        # 检查是否有循环依赖
3027|        if self._has_cycle():
3028|            errors.append("工作流存在循环依赖")
3029|        
3030|        return errors
3031|    
3032|    def _has_cycle(self) -> bool:
3033|        """检查工作流是否有循环依赖"""
3034|        graph = nx.DiGraph()
3035|        
3036|        # 添加节点
3037|        for step in self.steps:
3038|            graph.add_node(step.id)
3039|        
3040|        # 添加边
3041|        for step in self.steps:
3042|            # 成功跳转
3043|            for target_id in step.on_success:
3044|                graph.add_edge(step.id, target_id)
3045|            
3046|            # 失败跳转
3047|            for target_id in step.on_failure:
3048|                graph.add_edge(step.id, target_id)
3049|        
3050|        # 检查是否有环
3051|        try:
3052|            nx.find_cycle(graph)
3053|            return True
3054|        except nx.NetworkXNoCycle:
3055|            return False
3056|    
3057|    def get_start_steps(self) -> List[WorkflowStep]:
3058|        """获取起始步骤（没有前置依赖的步骤）"""
3059|        # 构建依赖图
3060|        dependencies = {step.id: set() for step in self.steps}
3061|        
3062|        for step in self.steps:
3063|            for target_id in step.on_success + step.on_failure:
3064|                if target_id in dependencies:
3065|                    dependencies[target_id].add(step.id)
3066|        
3067|        # 找到没有依赖的步骤
3068|        start_steps = []
3069|        for step in self.steps:
3070|            if not dependencies[step.id]:
3071|                start_steps.append(step)
3072|        
3073|        return start_steps
3074|

3078|            "id": self.id,

3088|                }

3090|            ],
3091|            "steps": [

3093|                    "id": step.id,

3096|                    "tool": step.tool,
3097|                    "params": step.params,
3098|                    "conditions": [

3106|                    "on_success": step.on_success,

3108|                    "retry_policy": step.retry_policy,
3109|                    "timeout": step.timeout,
3110|                    "parallel": step.parallel
3111|                }
3112|                for step in self.steps
3113|            ],
3114|            "variables": self.variables,
3115|            "input_schema": self.input_schema,
3116|            "output_schema": self.output_schema,
3117|            "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat(),
3118|            "updated_at": self.updated_at.isoformat()
3119|        }

3121|    @classmethod
3122|    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> 'WorkflowDefinition':
3123|        """从字典创建"""
3124|        # 转换触发器
3125|        triggers = []
3126|        for trigger_data in data.get("triggers", []):
3127|            trigger = Trigger(

3140|                condition = Condition(
3141|                    field=cond_data["field"],

3143|                    value=cond_data["value"]
3144|                )
3145|                conditions.append(condition)

3147|            step = WorkflowStep(

3152|                params=step_data.get("params", {}),

3154|                on_success=step_data.get("on_success", []),
3155|                on_failure=step_data.get("on_failure", []),
3156|                retry_policy=step_data.get("retry_policy", {"max_retries": 3, "backoff_factor": 2.0}),
3157|                timeout=step_data.get("timeout"),

3160|            steps.append(step)
3161|        
3162|        return cls(

3164|            name=data["name"],
3165|            description=data.get("description"),
3166|            version=data.get("version", "1.0.0"),
3167|            status=WorkflowStatus(data.get("status", "draft")),
3168|            triggers=triggers,
3169|            steps=steps,
3170|            variables=data.get("variables", {}),
3171|            input_schema=data.get("input_schema", {}),
3172|            output_schema=data.get("output_schema", {})
3173|        )
