3175|class WorkflowEngine:
3176|    """工作流引擎"""
3177|    
3178|    def __init__(self, tool_manager, chain_executor):
3179|        self.tool_manager = tool_manager
3180|        self.chain_executor = chain_executor
3181|        self.workflows: Dict[str, WorkflowDefinition] = {}
3182|        self.running_workflows: Dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
3183|        self.workflow_results: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
3184|        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
3185|    
3186|    def register_workflow(self, workflow: WorkflowDefinition) -> None:
3187|        """注册工作流"""
3188|        # 验证工作流
3189|        errors = workflow.validate()
3190|        if errors:
3191|            raise ValueError(f"工作流验证失败: {', '.join(errors)}")
3192|        
3193|        self.workflows[workflow.id] = workflow
3194|    
3195|    def get_workflow(self, workflow_id: str) -> Optional[WorkflowDefinition]:
3196|        """获取工作流"""
3197|        return self.workflows.get(workflow_id)
3198|    
3199|    def list_workflows(
3200|        self,
3201|        status: Optional[WorkflowStatus] = None,
3202|        limit: int = 100,
3203|        offset: int = 0
3204|    ) -> List[WorkflowDefinition]:
3205|        """列出工作流"""
3206|        workflows = list(self.workflows.values())
3207|        
3208|        # 状态过滤
3209|        if status:
3210|            workflows = [w for w in workflows if w.status == status]
3211|        
3212|        # 排序（按更新时间倒序）
3213|        workflows.sort(key=lambda w: w.updated_at, reverse=True)
3214|        
3215|        # 分页
3216|        return workflows[offset:offset + limit]
3217|    
3218|    async def execute_workflow(
3219|        self,
3220|        workflow_id: str,
3221|        inputs: Dict[str, Any],
3222|        context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
3223|    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3224|        """执行工作流"""
3225|        workflow = self.get_workflow(workflow_id)
3226|        if not workflow:
3227|            raise ValueError(f"工作流不存在: {workflow_id}")
3228|        
3229|        if workflow.status != WorkflowStatus.ACTIVE:
3230|            raise ValueError(f"工作流状态为 {workflow.status.value}，无法执行")
3231|        
3232|        # 创建执行ID
3233|        execution_id = f"{workflow_id}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f')}"
3234|        
3235|        # 创建执行任务
3236|        task = asyncio.create_task(
3237|            self._execute_workflow_internal(execution_id, workflow, inputs, context or {})
3238|        )
3239|        
3240|        # 保存运行状态
3241|        async with self._lock:
3242|            self.running_workflows[execution_id] = task
3243|        
3244|        try:
3245|            # 等待任务完成
3246|            result = await task
3247|            return result
3248|        finally:
3249|            # 清理运行状态
3250|            async with self._lock:
3251|                if execution_id in self.running_workflows:
3252|                    del self.running_workflows[execution_id]
3253|    
3254|    async def _execute_workflow_internal(
3255|        self,
3256|        execution_id: str,
3257|        workflow: WorkflowDefinition,
3258|        inputs: Dict[str, Any],
3259|        context: Dict[str, Any]
3260|    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3261|        """内部执行工作流"""
3262|        start_time = datetime.now()
3263|        
3264|        # 初始化执行上下文
3265|        execution_context = {
3266|            "execution_id": execution_id,
3267|            "workflow_id": workflow.id,
3268|            "inputs": inputs,
3269|            "context": context,
3270|            "variables": workflow.variables.copy(),
3271|            "step_results": {},
3272|            "current_step": None,
3273|            "status": "running",
3274|            "started_at": start_time.isoformat()
3275|        }
3276|        
3277|        try:
3278|            # 验证输入
3279|            validation_errors = self._validate_workflow_inputs(inputs, workflow.input_schema)
3280|            if validation_errors:
3281|                execution_context["status"] = "failed"
3282|                execution_context["error"] = f"输入验证失败: {', '.join(validation_errors)}"
3283|                execution_context["completed_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
3284|                self.workflow_results[execution_id] = execution_context
3285|                return execution_context
3286|            
3287|            # 获取起始步骤
3288|            start_steps = workflow.get_start_steps()
3289|            if not start_steps:
3290|                execution_context["status"] = "failed"
3291|                execution_context["error"] = "工作流没有起始步骤"
3292|                execution_context["completed_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
3293|                self.workflow_results[execution_id] = execution_context
3294|                return execution_context
3295|            
3296|            # 执行工作流
3297|            execution_context = await self._execute_workflow_steps(
3298|                workflow, start_steps, execution_context
3299|            )
3300|            
3301|            # 生成输出
3302|            if execution_context["status"] == "completed":
3303|                execution_context["output"] = self._generate_workflow_output(
3304|                    workflow, execution_context
3305|                )
3306|            
3307|        except Exception as e:
3308|            execution_context["status"] = "failed"
3309|            execution_context["error"] = f"工作流执行异常: {str(e)}"
3310|        finally:
3311|            # 计算执行时间
3312|            end_time = datetime.now()
3313|            execution_context["completed_at"] = end_time.isoformat()
3314|            execution_context["execution_time"] = (end_time - start_time).total_seconds()
3315|            
3316|            # 保存结果
3317|            self.workflow_results[execution_id] = execution_context
3318|        
3319|        return execution_context
3320|    
3321|    def _validate_workflow_inputs(
3322|        self,
3323|        inputs: Dict[str, Any],
3324|        input_schema: Dict[str, Any]
3325|    ) -> List[str]:
3326|        """验证工作流输入"""
3327|        # 简化实现，实际应该使用JSON Schema验证
3328|        errors = []
3329|        
3330|        required_fields = input_schema.get("required", [])
3331|        for field in required_fields:
3332|            if field not in inputs:
3333|                errors.append(f"缺少必需字段: {field}")
3334|        
3335|        return errors
3336|    
3337|    async def _execute_workflow_steps(
3338|        self,
3339|        workflow: WorkflowDefinition,
3340|        current_steps: List[WorkflowStep],
3341|        context: Dict[str, Any]
3342|    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3343|        """执行工作流步骤"""
3344|        # 创建步骤执行任务
3345|        step_tasks = []
3346|        for step in current_steps:
3347|            task = asyncio.create_task(
3348|                self._execute_workflow_step(workflow, step, context)
3349|            )
3350|            step_tasks.append((step.id, task))
3351|        
3352|        # 等待所有步骤完成
3353|        step_results = {}
3354|        for step_id, task in step_tasks:
3355|            try:
3356|                result = await task
3357|                step_results[step_id] = result
3358|            except Exception as e:
3359|                step_results[step_id] = {
3360|                    "status": "failed",
3361|                    "error": str(e),
3362|                    "step_id": step_id
3363|                }
3364|        
3365|        # 更新上下文
3366|        context["step_results"].update(step_results)
3367|        
3368|        # 检查执行结果
3369|        all_completed = True
3370|        next_steps = []
3371|        
3372|        for step_id, result in step_results.items():
3373|            if result["status"] == "success":
3374|                # 成功时跳转
3375|                step = next((s for s in workflow.steps if s.id == step_id), None)
3376|                if step:
3377|                    next_steps.extend([
3378|                        next((s for s in workflow.steps if s.id == target_id), None)
3379|                        for target_id in step.on_success
3380|                    ])
3381|            elif result["status"] == "failed":
3382|                # 失败时跳转
3383|                step = next((s for s in workflow.steps if s.id == step_id), None)
3384|                if step:
3385|                    next_steps.extend([
3386|                        next((s for s in workflow.steps if s.id == target_id), None)
3387|                        for target_id in step.on_failure
3388|                    ])
3389|            else:
3390|                all_completed = False
3391|        
3392|        # 过滤掉None（不存在的步骤）
3393|        next_steps = [step for step in next_steps if step is not None]
3394|        
3395|        # 如果没有下一步，工作流完成
3396|        if not next_steps:
3397|            context["status"] = "completed"
3398|            return context
3399|        
3400|        # 如果有下一步，继续执行
3401|        if all_completed:
3402|            # 递归执行下一步
3403|            return await self._execute_workflow_steps(workflow, next_steps, context)
3404|        else:
3405|            # 有步骤还在执行，等待
3406|            context["status"] = "running"
3407|            return context
3408|    
3409|    async def _execute_workflow_step(
3410|        self,
3411|        workflow: WorkflowDefinition,
3412|        step: WorkflowStep,
3413|        context: Dict[str, Any]
3414|    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3415|        """执行工作流步骤"""
3416|        step_start_time = datetime.now()
3417|        
3418|        result = {
3419|            "step_id": step.id,
3420|            "step_name": step.name,
3421|            "status": "pending",
3422|            "started_at": step_start_time.isoformat(),
3423|            "tool": step.tool
3424|        }
3425|        
3426|        try:
3427|            # 检查执行条件
3428|            if step.conditions:
3429|                conditions_met = all(
3430|                    condition.evaluate(context["variables"])
3431|                    for condition in step.conditions
3432|                )
3433|                if not conditions_met:
3434|                    result["status"] = "skipped"
3435|                    result["completed_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
3436|                    result["execution_time"] = 0.0
3437|                    return result
3438|            
3439|            # 准备参数
3440|            params = self._prepare_workflow_step_params(step.params, context)
3441|            
3442|            # 更新上下文
3443|            context["current_step"] = step.id
3444|            
3445|            # 执行工具或工具链
3446|            if step.tool.startswith("chain:"):
3447|                # 执行工具链
3448|                chain_id = step.tool[6:]  # 去掉"chain:"前缀
3449|                chain_result = await self.chain_executor.execute_chain(
3450|                    chain_id=chain_id,
3451|                    inputs=params,
3452|                    context=context
3453|                )
3454|                
3455|                result["output"] = chain_result.output
3456|                result["status"] = chain_result.status.value
3457|                if chain_result.error:
3458|                    result["error"] = chain_result.error
3459|                
3460|            else:
3461|                # 执行单个工具
3462|                # 这里应该调用工具执行器
3463|                # 简化实现，直接返回模拟结果
3464|                result["output"] = {"params": params, "context": context}
3465|                result["status"] = "success"
3466|            
3467|            # 更新工作流变量
3468|            if result["status"] == "success" and result.get("output"):
3469|                context["variables"][f"step_{step.id}_output"] = result["output"]
3470|            
3471|        except Exception as e:
3472|            result["status"] = "failed"
3473|            result["error"] = str(e)
3474|        finally:
3475|            # 计算执行时间
3476|            step_end_time = datetime.now()
3477|            result["completed_at"] = step_end_time.isoformat()
3478|            result["execution_time"] = (step_end_time - step_start_time).total_seconds()
3479|        
3480|        return result
3481|    
3482|    def _prepare_workflow_step_params(
3483|        self,
3484|        params: Dict[str, Any],
3485|        context: Dict[str, Any]
3486|    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3487|        """准备工作流步骤参数"""
3488|        # 与工具链类似的参数准备逻辑
3489|        # 支持变量替换：{{variable.path}}
3490|        
3491|        def resolve_value(value):
3492|            if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("{{") and value.endswith("}}"):
3493|                # 变量引用
3494|                var_path = value[2:-2].strip()
3495|                return self._resolve_workflow_variable(var_path, context)
3496|            elif isinstance(value, dict):
3497|                # 递归处理字典
3498|                return {k: resolve_value(v) for k, v in value.items()}
3499|            elif isinstance(value, list):
3500|                # 递归处理列表
3501|                return [resolve_value(item) for item in value]
3502|            else:
3503|                return value
3504|        
3505|        return {k: resolve_value(v) for k, v in params.items()}
3506|    
3507|    def _resolve_workflow_variable(self, var_path: str, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
3508|        """解析工作流变量"""
3509|        # 支持多种变量来源：
3510|        # inputs.field - 工作流输入
3511|        # variables.field - 工作流变量
3512|        # step_{step_id}_output.field - 步骤输出
3513|        # context.field - 执行上下文
3514|        
3515|        parts = var_path.split(".")
3516|        if len(parts) < 2:
3517|            raise ValueError(f"无效的变量路径: {var_path}")
3518|        
3519|        source = parts[0]
3520|        path = parts[1:]
3521|        
3522|        if source == "inputs":
3523|            current = context.get("inputs", {})
3524|        elif source == "variables":
3525|            current = context.get("variables", {})
3526|        elif source.startswith("step_") and source.endswith("_output"):
3527|            step_id = source[5:-7]  # 去掉"step_"和"_output"
3528|            current = context.get("step_results", {}).get(step_id, {}).get("output", {})
3529|        elif source == "context":
3530|            current = context.get("context", {})
3531|        else:
3532|            raise ValueError(f"未知的变量来源: {source}")
3533|        
3534|        # 遍历路径
3535|        for part in path:
3536|            if isinstance(current, dict) and part in current:
3537|                current = current[part]
3538|            elif isinstance(current, list):
3539|                try:
3540|                    idx = int(part)
3541|                    current = current[idx]
3542|                except (ValueError, IndexError):
3543|                    raise ValueError(f"无法解析变量路径: {var_path}")
3544|            else:
3545|                raise ValueError(f"无法解析变量路径: {var_path}")
3546|        
3547|        return current
3548|    
3549|    def _generate_workflow_output(
3550|        self,
3551|        workflow: WorkflowDefinition,
3552|        context: Dict[str, Any]
3553|    ) -> Any:
3554|        """生成工作流输出"""
3555|        output_schema = workflow.output_schema
3556|        
3557|        if not output_schema:
3558|            # 如果没有定义输出schema，返回所有步骤结果
3559|            return {
3560|                "step_results": context["step_results"],
3561|                "variables": context["variables"]
3562|            }
3563|        
3564|        # 根据输出schema生成输出
3565|        output = {}
3566|        for field, field_schema in output_schema.get("properties", {}).items():
3567|            mapping = field_schema.get("mapping")
3568|            if mapping:
3569|                output[field] = self._resolve_workflow_variable(mapping, context)
3570|            else:
3571|                output[field] = context.get("variables", {}).get(field)
3572|        
3573|        return output
3574|    
3575|    async def cancel_workflow(self, execution_id: str) -> bool:
3576|        """取消工作流执行"""
3577|        async with self._lock:
3578|            task = self.running_workflows.get(execution_id)
3579|            if task:
3580|                task.cancel()
3581|                return True
3582|            return False
3583|    
3584|    def get_workflow_status(self, execution_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
3585|        """获取工作流执行状态"""
3586|        # 检查是否正在运行
3587|        async with self._lock:
3588|            if execution_id in self.running_workflows:
3589|                return {
3590|                    "execution_id": execution_id,
3591|                    "status": "running",
3592|                    "started_at": datetime.now().isoformat()
3593|                }
3594|        
3595|        # 检查是否有结果
3596|        return self.workflow_results.get(execution_id)
3597|    
3598|    def list_running_workflows(self) -> List[str]:
3599|        """列出正在运行的工作流"""
3600|        return list(self.running_workflows.keys())
3601|    
3602|    def list_completed_workflows(
3603|        self,
3604|        workflow_id: Optional[str] = None,
3605|        limit: int = 100,
3606|        offset: int = 0
3607|    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3608|        """列出已完成的工作流"""
3609|        results = list(self.workflow_results.values())
3610|        
3611|        # 工作流ID过滤
3612|        if workflow_id:
3613|            results = [r for r in results if r.get("workflow_id") == workflow_id]
3614|        
3615|        # 排序（按完成时间倒序）
3616|        results.sort(
3617|            key=lambda x: x.get("completed_at") or "0000-00-00T00:00:00",
3618|            reverse=True
3619|        )
3620|        
3621|        # 分页
3622|        return results[offset:offset + limit]
3623|    
3624|    def export_workflow(self, workflow_id: str, format: str = "json") -> str:
3625|        """导出工作流定义"""
3626|        workflow = self.get_workflow(workflow_id)
3627|        if not workflow:
3628|            raise ValueError(f"工作流不存在: {workflow_id}")
3629|        
3630|        data = workflow.to_dict()
3631|        
3632|        if format == "json":
3633|            return json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
3634|        elif format == "yaml":
3635|            return yaml.dump(data, allow_unicode=True, sort_keys=False)
3636|        else:
3637|            raise ValueError(f"不支持的格式: {format}")
3638|    
3639|    def import_workflow(self, data: Union[str, Dict]) -> str:
3640|        """导入工作流定义"""
3641|        if isinstance(data, str):
3642|            try:
3643|                data = json.loads(data)
3644|            except json.JSONDecodeError:
3645|                data = yaml.safe_load(data)
3646|        
3647|        workflow = WorkflowDefinition.from_dict(data)
3648|        
3649|        # 验证工作流
3650|        errors = workflow.validate()
3651|        if errors:
3652|            raise ValueError(f"工作流验证失败: {', '.join(errors)}")
3653|        
3654|        # 注册工作流
3655|        self.register_workflow(workflow)
3656|        
3657|        return workflow.id
3658|```

3664|### 7.1 权限控制系统
3665|
3666|```python
3667|# backend/app/services/tools/security.py
3668|from typing import Dict, List, Set, Optional, Any
3669|from dataclasses import dataclass, field
3670|from datetime import datetime
3671|from enum import Enum
3672|import hashlib
3673|import hmac
3674|import secrets
3675|from functools import wraps
3676|
3677|class PermissionLevel(str, Enum):
3678|    """权限级别"""
3679|    NONE = "none"        # 无权限
3680|    READ = "read"        # 读取权限
3681|    WRITE = "write"      # 写入权限
3682|    EXECUTE = "execute"  # 执行权限
3683|    ADMIN = "admin"      # 管理员权限
3684|
3685|class ResourceType(str, Enum):
3686|    """资源类型"""
3687|    TOOL = "tool"                # 工具
3688|    TOOL_CHAIN = "tool_chain"    # 工具链
3689|    WORKFLOW = "workflow"        # 工作流
3690|    FILE = "file"                # 文件
3691|    DATABASE = "database"        # 数据库
3692|    NETWORK = "network"          # 网络
3693|    SYSTEM = "system"            # 系统
3694|
3695|@dataclass
3696|class User:
3697|    """用户"""
3698|    id: str
3699|    username: str
3700|    email: str
3701|    roles: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
3702|    permissions: Dict[str, PermissionLevel] = field(default_factory=dict)
3703|    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
3704|    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
3705|    is_active: bool = True
3706|    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
3707|
3708|@dataclass
3709|class Role:
3710|    """角色"""
3711|    id: str
3712|    name: str
3713|    description: str = ""
3714|    permissions: Dict[str, PermissionLevel] = field(default_factory=dict)
3715|    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
3716|    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
3717|
3718|@dataclass
3719|class Resource:
3720|    """资源"""
3721|    id: str
3722|    type: ResourceType
3723|    name: str
3724|    description: str = ""
3725|    owner: str = ""  # 所有者用户ID
3726|    required_permission: PermissionLevel = PermissionLevel.EXECUTE
3727|    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
3728|    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
3729|    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
3730|
3731|class PermissionManager:
3732|    """权限管理器"""
3733|    
3734|    def __init__(self):
3735|        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}
3736|        self.roles: Dict[str, Role] = {}
3737|        self.resources: Dict[str, Resource] = {}
3738|        self._user_sessions: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
3739|        
3740|        # 初始化内置角色
3741|        self._initialize_builtin_roles()
3742|    
3743|    def _initialize_builtin_roles(self) -> None:
3744|        """初始化内置角色"""
3745|        # 管理员角色
3746|        admin_role = Role(
3747|            id="admin",
3748|            name="管理员",
3749|            description="系统管理员，拥有所有权限",
3750|            permissions={
3751|                "*": PermissionLevel.ADMIN
3752|            }
3753|        )
3754|        self.roles[admin_role.id] = admin_role
3755|        
3756|        # 开发者角色
3757|        developer_role = Role(
3758|            id="developer",
3759|            name="开发者",
3760|            description="工具开发者，可以创建和执行工具",
3761|            permissions={
3762|                "tool:*": PermissionLevel.WRITE,
3763|                "tool_chain:*": PermissionLevel.WRITE,
3764|                "workflow:*": PermissionLevel.WRITE
3765|            }
3766|        )
3767|        self.roles[developer_role.id] = developer_role
3768|        
3769|        # 用户角色
3770|        user_role = Role(
3771|            id="user",
3772|            name="用户",
3773|            description="普通用户，可以执行工具",
3774|            permissions={
3775|                "tool:*": PermissionLevel.EXECUTE,
3776|                "tool_chain:*": PermissionLevel.EXECUTE,
3777|                "workflow:*": PermissionLevel.EXECUTE
3778|            }
3779|        )
3780|        self.roles[user_role.id] = user_role
3781|        
3782|        # 只读角色
3783|        viewer_role = Role(
3784|            id="viewer",
3785|            name="查看者",
3786|            description="只读用户，可以查看工具",
3787|            permissions={
3788|                "tool:*": PermissionLevel.READ,
3789|                "tool_chain:*": PermissionLevel.READ,
3790|                "workflow:*": PermissionLevel.READ
3791|            }
3792|        )
3793|        self.roles[viewer_role.id] = viewer_role
3794|    
3795|    def create_user(
3796|        self,
3797|        username: str,
3798|        email: str,
3799|        roles: List[str] = None,
3800|        permissions: Dict[str, PermissionLevel] = None,
3801|        metadata: Dict[str, Any] = None
3802|    ) -> User:
3803|        """创建用户"""
3804|        user_id = hashlib.sha256(f"{username}:{email}:{datetime.now().isoformat()}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
3805|        
3806|        user = User(
3807|            id=user_id,
3808|            username=username,
3809|            email=email,
3810|            roles=roles or ["user"],
3811|            permissions=permissions or {},
3812|            metadata=metadata or {}
3813|        )
3814|        
3815|        self.users[user_id] = user
3816|        return user
3817|    
3818|    def authenticate_user(self, username: str, password: str) -> Optional[str]:
3819|        """用户认证（简化实现）"""
3820|        # 在实际实现中，这里应该验证密码
3821|        # 这里使用简化实现
3822|        for user in self.users.values():
3823|            if user.username == username and user.is_active:
3824|                # 生成会话令牌
3825|                session_token = self._create_session_token(user.id)
3826|                return session_token
3827|        return None
3828|    
3829|    def _create_session_token(self, user_id: str) -> str:
3830|        """创建会话令牌"""
3831|        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
3832|        self._user_sessions[token] = {
3833|            "user_id": user_id,
3834|            "created_at": datetime.now(),
3835|            "last_accessed": datetime.now()
3836|        }
3837|        return token
3838|    
3839|    def validate_session(self, session_token: str) -> Optional[User]:
3840|        """验证会话令牌"""
3841|        session = self._user_sessions.get(session_token)
3842|        if not session:
3843|            return None
3844|        
3845|        # 检查会话是否过期（24小时）
3846|        if (datetime.now() - session["created_at"]).total_seconds() > 24 * 3600:
3847|            del self._user_sessions[session_token]
3848|            return None
3849|        
3850|        # 更新最后访问时间
3851|        session["last_accessed"] = datetime.now()
3852|        
3853|        # 返回用户
3854|        return self.users.get(session["user_id"])
3855|    
3856|    def check_permission(
3857|        self,
3858|        user: User,
3859|        resource_type: ResourceType,
3860|        resource_id: str,
3861|        required_permission: PermissionLevel
3862|    ) -> bool:
3863|        """检查用户权限"""
3864|        # 构建资源标识符
3865|        resource_key = f"{resource_type.value}:{resource_id}"
3866|        
3867|        # 检查用户直接权限
3868|        user_permission = user.permissions.get(resource_key)
3869|        if user_permission and self._permission_sufficient(user_permission, required_permission):
3870|            return True
3871|        
3872|        # 检查通配符权限
3873|        wildcard_key = f"{resource_type.value}:*"
3874|        user_wildcard_permission = user.permissions.get(wildcard_key)
3875|        if user_wildcard_permission and self._permission_sufficient(user_wildcard_permission, required_permission):
3876|            return True
3877|        
3878|        # 检查全局通配符权限
3879|        global_permission = user.permissions.get("*")
3880|        if global_permission and self._permission_sufficient(global_permission, required_permission):
3881|            return True
3882|        
3883|        # 检查角色权限
3884|        for role_id in user.roles:
3885|            role = self.roles.get(role_id)
3886|            if not role:
3887|                continue
3888|            
3889|            # 检查角色直接权限
3890|            role_permission = role.permissions.get(resource_key)
3891|            if role_permission and self._permission_sufficient(role_permission, required_permission):
3892|                return True
3893|            
3894|            # 检查角色通配符权限
3895|            role_wildcard_permission = role.permissions.get(wildcard_key)
3896|            if role_wildcard_permission and self._permission_sufficient(role_wildcard_permission, required_permission):
3897|                return True
3898|            
3899|            # 检查角色全局权限
3900|            role_global_permission = role.permissions.get("*")
3901|            if role_global_permission and self._permission_sufficient(role_global_permission, required_permission):
3902|                return True
3903|        
3904|        return False
3905|    
3906|    def _permission_sufficient(
3907|        self,
3908|        user_permission: PermissionLevel,
3909|        required_permission: PermissionLevel
3910|    ) -> bool:
3911|        """检查用户权限是否满足要求"""
3912|        permission_order = {
3913|            PermissionLevel.NONE: 0,
3914|            PermissionLevel.READ: 1,
3915|            PermissionLevel.WRITE: 2,
3916|            PermissionLevel.EXECUTE: 3,
3917|            PermissionLevel.ADMIN: 4
3918|        }
3919|        
3920|        return permission_order[user_permission] >= permission_order[required_permission]
3921|    
3922|    def grant_permission(
3923|        self,
3924|        user_id: str,
3925|        resource_type: ResourceType,
3926|        resource_id: str,
3927|        permission: PermissionLevel
3928|    ) -> bool:
3929|        """授予权限"""
3930|        user = self.users.get(user_id)
3931|        if not user:
3932|            return False
3933|        
3934|        resource_key = f"{resource_type.value}:{resource_id}"
3935|        user.permissions[resource_key] = permission
3936|        user.updated_at = datetime.now()
3937|        
3938|        return True
3939|    
3940|    def revoke_permission(
3941|        self,
3942|        user_id: str,
3943|        resource_type: ResourceType,
3944|        resource_id: str
3945|    ) -> bool:
3946|        """撤销权限"""
3947|        user = self.users.get(user_id)
3948|        if not user:
3949|            return False
3950|        
3951|        resource_key = f"{resource_type.value}:{resource_id}"
3952|        if resource_key in user.permissions:
3953|            del user.permissions[resource_key]
3954|            user.updated_at = datetime.now()
3955|            return True
3956|        
3957|        return False
3958|    
3959|    def create_resource(
3960|        self,
3961|        resource_type: ResourceType,
3962|        name: str,
3963|        owner: str,
3964|        required_permission: PermissionLevel = PermissionLevel.EXECUTE,
3965|        description: str = "",
3966|        metadata: Dict[str, Any] = None
3967|    ) -> Resource:
3968|        """创建资源"""
3969|        resource_id = hashlib.sha256(f"{resource_type.value}:{name}:{datetime.now().isoformat()}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
3970|        
3971|        resource = Resource(
3972|            id=resource_id,
3973|            type=resource_type,
3974|            name=name,
3975|            description=description,
3976|            owner=owner,
3977|            required_permission=required_permission,
3978|            metadata=metadata or {}
3979|        )
3980|        
3981|        self.resources[resource_id] = resource
3982|        return resource
3983|    
3984|    def get_user_permissions(self, user_id: str) -> Dict[str, PermissionLevel]:
3985|        """获取用户所有权限"""
3986|        user = self.users.get(user_id)
3987|        if not user:
3988|            return {}
3989|        
3990|        # 合并用户直接权限和角色权限
3991|        all_permissions = user.permissions.copy()
3992|        
3993|        for role_id in user.roles:
3994|            role = self.roles.get(role_id)
3995|            if role:
3996|                for resource_key, permission in role.permissions.items():
3997|                    # 角色权限覆盖用户权限
3998|                    if resource_key not in all_permissions or \
3999|                       self._permission_sufficient(permission, all_permissions[resource_key]):
4000|                        all_permissions[resource_key] = permission
4001|        
4002|        return all_permissions
4003|    
4004|    def export_permissions(self, format: str = "json") -> str:
4005|        """导出权限配置"""
4006|        data = {
4007|            "users": {
4008|                user_id: {
4009|                    "username": user.username,
4010|                    "email": user.email,
4011|                    "roles": user.roles,
4012|                    "permissions": {
4013|                        resource_key: perm.value
4014|                        for resource_key, perm in user.permissions.items()
4015|                    },
4016|                    "is_active": user.is_active
4017|                }
4018|                for user_id, user in self.users.items()
4019|            },
4020|            "roles": {
4021|                role_id: {
4022|                    "name": role.name,
4023|                    "description": role.description,
4024|                    "permissions": {
4025|                        resource_key: perm.value
4026|                        for resource_key, perm in role.permissions.items()
4027|                    }
4028|                }
4029|                for role_id, role in self.roles.items()
4030|            },
4031|            "resources": {
4032|                resource_id: {
4033|                    "type": resource.type.value,
4034|                    "name": resource.name,
4035|                    "description": resource.description,
4036|                    "owner": resource.owner,
4037|                    "required_permission": resource.required_permission.value
4038|                }
4039|                for resource_id, resource in self.resources.items()
4040|            }
4041|        }
4042|        
4043|        if format == "json":
4044|            return json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
4045|        elif format == "yaml":
4046|            import yaml
4047|            return yaml.dump(data, allow_unicode=True, sort_keys=False)
4048|        else:
4049|            raise ValueError(f"不支持的格式: {format}")
4050|
4051|def require_permission(
4052|    resource_type: ResourceType,
4053|    resource_id_getter: Callable = None,
4054|    required_permission: PermissionLevel = PermissionLevel.EXECUTE
4055|):
4056|    """权限检查装饰器"""
4057|    def decorator(func):
4058|        @wraps(func)
4059|        async def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
4060|            # 获取用户（从请求上下文或参数）
4061|            user = kwargs.get("user")
4062|            if not user:
4063|                # 尝试从请求上下文获取
4064|                from app.utils.context import get_current_user
4065|                user = get_current_user()
4066|            
4067|            if not user:
4068|                raise PermissionError("未认证的用户")
4069|            
4070|            # 获取资源ID
4071|            if resource_id_getter:
4072|                resource_id = resource_id_getter(*args, **kwargs)
4073|            else:
4074|                # 默认从kwargs中获取
4075|                resource_id = kwargs.get("resource_id") or kwargs.get("tool_id") or kwargs.get("chain_id") or kwargs.get("workflow_id")
4076|            
4077|            if not resource_id:
4078|                raise ValueError("无法确定资源ID")
4079|            
4080|            # 检查权限
4081|            permission_manager = PermissionManager()  # 实际应该使用单例
4082|            if not permission_manager.check_permission(user, resource_type, resource_id, required_permission):
4083|                raise PermissionError(f"用户没有{required_permission.value}权限访问资源{resource_type.value}:{resource_id}")
4084|            
4085|            # 执行函数
4086|            return await func(*args, **kwargs)
4087|        
4088|        return wrapper
4089|    
4090|    return decorator
4091|
4092|# 使用示例
4093|@require_permission(ResourceType.TOOL, lambda tool_id: tool_id, PermissionLevel.EXECUTE)
4094|async def execute_tool(tool_id: str, params: Dict[str, Any], user: User = None):
4095|    """执行工具（需要执行权限）"""
4096|    # 工具执行逻辑
4097|    pass
4098|
4099|@require_permission(ResourceType.TOOL_CHAIN, lambda chain_id: chain_id, PermissionLevel.WRITE)
4100|async def create_tool_chain(chain_id: str, definition: Dict[str, Any], user: User = None):
4101|    """创建工具链（需要写入权限）"""
4102|    # 工具链创建逻辑
4103|    pass
4104|
4105|@require_permission(ResourceType.WORKFLOW, lambda workflow_id: workflow_id, PermissionLevel.READ)
4106|async def get_workflow(workflow_id: str, user: User = None):
4107|    """获取工作流（需要读取权限）"""
4108|    # 工作流获取逻辑
4109|    pass
4110|```

4113|
4114|```python
4115|# backend/app/services/tools/sandbox.py
4116|import asyncio
4117|import tempfile
4118|import shutil
4119|import os
4120|import resource
4121|import signal
4122|import subprocess
4123|from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List, Tuple
4124|from dataclasses import dataclass, field
4125|from datetime import datetime
4126|import json
4127|import yaml
4128|
4129|class SandboxConfig:
4130|    """沙箱配置"""
4131|    
4132|    def __init__(
4133|        self,
4134|        memory_limit_mb: int = 512,
4135|        cpu_limit_percent: int = 50,
4136|        disk_limit_mb: int = 1024,
4137|        network_enabled: bool = False,
4138|        read_only_filesystem: bool = True,
4139|        allowed_commands: List[str] = None,
4140|        blocked_commands: List[str] = None,
4141|        allowed_ports: List[int] = None,
4142|        blocked_ports: List[int] = None,
4143|        timeout_seconds: int = 30,
4144|        working_directory: Optional[str] = None
4145|    ):
4146|        self.memory_limit_mb = memory_limit_mb
4147|        self.cpu_limit_percent = cpu_limit_percent
4148|        self.disk_limit_mb = disk_limit_mb
4149|        self.network_enabled = network_enabled
4150|        self.read_only_filesystem = read_only_filesystem
4151|        self.allowed_commands = allowed_commands or []
4152|        self.blocked_commands = blocked_commands or []
4153|        self.allowed_ports = allowed_ports or []
4154|        self#blocked_ports = blocked_ports or []
4155|        self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds
4156|        self.working_directory = working_directory
4157|
4158|@dataclass
4159|class SandboxResult:
4160|    """沙箱执行结果"""
4161|    success: boolRR
4162|    output: str
4163|    error: Optional[str] = None
4164|    exit_code: Optional[int] = None
4165|    execution_time: float = 0.0
4166|   RRmemory_used_mb: float = 0.0
4167|    cpu_used_percent: float = 0.0
4168|    disk_used_mb: float = 0.0
4169|
4170|class SandboxExecutor:
4171|    """沙箱执行器 - 提供隔离的执行环境"""
4172|    
4173|    def __init__(self, config: Optional[SandboxConfig] = None):
4174|        self.config = config or SandboxConfig()
4175|        self._temp_dirs: List[str] = []
4176|    
4177|    async def execute_command(
4178|        self,
4179|        command: str,
4180|        args: List[str] = None,
4181|        input_data: Optional[str] = None,
4182|        env: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
4183|    ) -> SandboxResult:
4184|        """在沙箱中执行命令"""
4185|        start_time = datetime.now()
4186|        
4187|        try:
4188|            # 创建临时工作目录
4189|            work_dir = self._create_work_directory()
4190|            
4191|            # 准备命令
4192|            full_command = [command]
4193|            if args:
4194|                full_command.extend(args)
4195|            
4196|            # 检查命令是否允许
4197|            if not self._is_command_allowed(command):
4198|                return SandboxResult(
4199|                    success=False,
4200|                    output="",
4201|                    error=f"命令被阻止: {command}",
4202|                    execution_time=(datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()
4203|                )
4204|            
4205|            # 设置资源限制
4206|            resource_limits = self._get_resource_limits()
4207|            
4208|            # 执行命令
4209|            result = await self._run_in_sandbox(
4210|                full_command, work_dir, input_data, env, resource_limits
4211|            )
4212|            
4213|            # 清理工作目录
4214|            self._cleanup_work_directory(work_dir)
4215|            
4216|            return result
4217|            
4218|        except Exception as e:
4219|            return SandboxResult(
4220|                success=False,
4221|                output="",
4222|                error=f"沙箱执行异常: {str(e)}",
4223|                execution_time=(datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()
4224|            )
4225|    
4226|    def _create_work_directory(self) -> str:
4227|        """创建临时工作目录"""
4228|        temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="sandbox_")
4229|        self._temp_dirs.append(temp_dir)
4230|        return temp_dir
4231|    
4232|    def _cleanup_work_directory(self, work_dir: str) -> None:
4233|        """清理工作目录"""
4234|        try:
4235|            if os.path.exists(work_dir):
4236|                shutil.rmtree(work_dir)
4237|            if work_dir in self._temp_dirs:
4238|                self._temp_dirs.remove(work_dir)
4239|        except Exception as e:
4240|            print(f"清理工作目录失败: {e}")
4241|    
4242|    def _is_command_allowed(self, command: str) -> bool:
4243|        """检查命令是否允许执行"""
4244|        # 检查阻止的命令
4245|        for blocked in self.config.blocked_commands:
4246|            if blocked in command:
4247|                return False
4248|        
4249|        # 检查允许的命令
4250|        if self.config.allowed_commands:
4251|            for allowed in self.config.allowed_commands:
4252|                if allowed in command:
4253|                    return True
4254|            return False
4255|        
4256|        return True
4257|    
4258|    def _get_resource_limits(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
4259|        """获取资源限制配置"""
4260|        limits = {}
4261|        
4262|        # 内存限制
4263|        if self.config.memory_limit_mb > 0:
4264|            limits["memory"] = self.config.memory_limit_mb * 1024 * 1024  # 转换为字节
4265|        
4266|        # CPU限制
4267|        if self.config.cpu_limit_percent > 0:
4268|            limits["cpu_percent"] = self.config.cpu_limit_percent
4269|        
4270|        # 磁盘限制
4271|        if self.config.disk_limit_mb > 0:
4272|            limits["disk"] = self.config.disk_limit_mb * 1024 * 1024  # 转换为字节
4273|        
4274|        return limits
4275|    
4276|    async def _run_in_sandbox(
4277|        self,
4278|        command: List[str],
4279|        work_dir: str,
4280|        input_data: Optional[str],
4281|        env: Optional[Dict[str, str]],
4282|        resource_limits: Dict[str, Any]
4283|    ) -> SandboxResult:
4284|        """在沙箱中运行命令"""
4285|        # 准备环境变量
4286|        process_env = os.environ.copy()
4287|        if env:
4288|            process_env.update(env)
4289|        
4290|        # 设置工作RR目录
4291|        if self.config.working_directory:
4292|            work_dir = self.config.working_directory
4293|        
4294|        # 执行命令
4295|        try:
4296|            # 这里应该使用实际的沙箱执行实现
4297|            # 例如使用subprocess或容器技术
4298|            import subprocess
4299|            import time
4300|            
4301|            start_time = time.time()
4302|            process = subprocess.run(
4303|                command,
4304|                cwd=work_dir,
4305|                env=process_env,
4306|                input=input_data.encode() if input_data else None,
4307|                capture_output=True,
4308|                text=True,
4309|                timeout=self.config.timeout_seconds
4310|            )
4311|            
4312|            execution_time = time.time() - start_time
4313|            
4314|            return SandboxResult(
4315|                success=process.returncode == 0,
4316|                output=process.stdout,
4317|                error=process.stderr,
4318|                exit_code=process.returncode,
4319|                execution_time=execution_time,
4320|                memory_used_mb=0.0,  # 实际实现中需要监控资源使用
4321|                cpu_used_percent=0.0,
4322|                disk_used_mb=0.0
4323|            )
4324|            
4325|        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
4326|            return SandboxResult(
4327|                success=False,
4328|                output="",
4329|                error=f"命令执行超时（{self.config.timeout_seconds}秒）",
4330|                execution_time=self.config.timeout_seconds
4331|            )
4332|        except Exception as e:
4333|            return SandboxResult(
4334|                success=False,
4335|                output="",
4336|                error=f"命令执行失败: {str(e)}",
4337|                execution_time=time.time() - start_time
4338|            )
4339|
4340|    def cleanup(self) -> None:
4341|        """清理所有临时资源"""
4342|        for temp_dir in self._temp_dirs[:]:
4343|            self._cleanup_work_directory(temp_dir)

4346|class ToolSecurityManager:
4347|    """工具安全管理器"""
4348|    
4349|    def __init__(self, permission_manager: PermissionManager, sandbox_executor: SandboxExecutor):
4350|        self.permission_manager = permission_manager
4351|        self.sandbox_executor = sandbox_executor
4352|        self._audit_log: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
4353|    
4354|    async def execute_tool_with_security(
4355|        self,
4356|        user_id: str,
4357|        tool_id: str,
4358|        tool_metadata: ToolMetadata,
4359|        parameters: Dict[str, Any]
4360|    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
4361|        """在安全控制下执行工具"""
4362|        # 1. 权限检查
4363|        if not self.permission_manager.check_permission(user_id, tool_id, "execute"):
4364|            raise PermissionError(f"用户 {user_id} 没有执行工具 {tool_id} 的权限")
4365|        
4366|        # 2. 参数验证
4367|        self._validate_parameters(tool_metadata, parameters)
4368|        
4369|        # 3. 安全检查
4370|        if not self._check_security_policy(tool_metadata, parameters):
4371|            raise SecurityError(f"工具 {tool_id} 的安全检查失败")
4372|        
4373|        # 4. 记录审计日志
4374|        self._log_audit(user_id, tool_id, parameters, "execute_start")
4375|        
4376|        try:
4377|            # 5. 根据工具类型选择执行方式
4378|            result = await self._execute_tool(tool_metadata, parameters)
4379|            
4380|            # 6. 记录成功审计日志
4381|            self._log_audit(user_id, tool_id, parameters, "execute_success", result)
4382|            
4383|            return result
4384|            
4385|        except Exception as e:
4386|            # 7. 记录失败审计日志
4387|            self._log_audit(user_id, tool_id, parameters, "execute_failed", error=str(e))
4388|            raise
4389|    
4390|    def _validate_parameters(self, tool_metadata: ToolMetadata, parameters: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
4391|        """验证工具参数"""
4392|        # 检查必需参数
4393|        for param_name, param_spec in tool_metadata.requirements.parameters.items():
4394|            if param_spec.required and param_name not in parameters:
4395|                raise ValueError(f"缺少必需参数: {param_name}")
4396|        
4397|        # 检查参数类型
4398|        for param_name, param_value in parameters.items():
4399|            if param_name in tool_metadata.requirements.parameters:
4400|                param_spec = tool_metadata.requirements.parameters[param_name]
4401|                if not self._check_parameter_type(param_value, param_spec.type):
4402|                    raise TypeError(f"参数 {param_name} 类型不匹配: 期望 {param_spec.type}, 实际 {type(param_value)}")
4403|    
4404|    def _check_parameter_type(self, value: Any, expected_type: str) -> bool:
4405|        """检查参数类型"""
4406|        type_map = {
4407|            "string": str,
4408|            "integer": int,
4409|            "number": (int, float),
4410|            "boolean": bool,
4411|            "array": list,
4412|            "object": dict
4413|        }
4414|        
4415|        if expected_type not in type_map:
4416|            return True  # 未知类型，跳过检查
4417|        
4418|        expected = type_map[expected_type]
4419|        if isinstance(expected, tuple):
4420|            return isinstance(value, expected)
4421|        return isinstance(value, expected)
4422|    
4423|    def _check_security_policy(self, tool_metadata: ToolMetadata, parameters: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
4424|        """检查安全策略"""
4425|        # 检查工具权限要求
4426|        for permission in tool_metadata.permissions:
4427|            if not self.permission_manager.has_permission(permission):
4428|                return False
4429|        
4430|        # 检查参数安全
4431|        for param_name, param_value in parameters.items():
4432|            if isinstance(param_value, str):
4433|                # 检查SQL注入
4434|                if self._contains_sql_injection(param_value):
4435|                    return False
4436|                
4437|                # 检查命令注入
4438|                if self._contains_command_injection(param_value):
4439|                    return False
4440|        
4441|        return True
4442|    
4443|    def _contains_sql_injection(self, value: str) -> bool:
4444|        """检查是否包含SQL注入"""
4445|        sql_keywords = ["SELECT", "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE", "DROP", "UNION", "OR", "AND"]
4446|        value_upper = value.upper()
4447|        for keyword in sql_keywords:
4448|            if keyword in value_upper:
4449|                return True
4450|        return False
4451|    
4452|    def _contains_command_injection(self, value: str) -> bool:
4453|        """检查是否包含命令注入"""
4454|        dangerous_chars = [";", "|", "&", "`", "$", "(", ")", "<", ">"]
4455|        for char in dangerous_chars:
4456|            if char in value:
4457|                return True
4458|        return False
4459|    
4460|    async def _execute_tool(self, tool_metadata: ToolMetadata, parameters: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
4461|        """执行工具"""
4462|        # 根据工具类型选择执行方式
4463|        if tool_metadata.type == ToolType.SYSTEM_COMMAND:
4464|            # 系统命令在沙箱中执行
4465|            command = parameters.get("command", "")
4466|            args = parameters.get("args", [])
4467|            return await self._execute_system_command(command, args)
4468|        
4469|        elif tool_metadata.type == ToolType.FILE_OPERATION:
4470|            # 文件操作需要特殊权限检查
4471|            return await self._execute_file_operation(parameters)
4472|        
4473|        else:
4474|            # 其他工具类型直接调用
4475|            return await self._call_tool_function(tool_metadata, parameters)
4476|    
4477|    async def _execute_system_command(self, command: str, args: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
4478|        """在沙箱中执行系统命令"""
4479|        result = await self.sandbox_executor.execute_command(command, args)
4480|        
4481|        return {
4482|            "success": result.success,
4483|            "output": result.output,
4484|            "error": result.error,
4485|            "exit_code": result.exit_code,
4486|            "execution_time": result.execution_time
4487|        }
4488|    
4489|    async def _execute_file_operation(self, parameters: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
4490|        """执行文件操作"""
4491|        operation = parameters.get("operation", "")
4492|        path = parameters.get("path", "")
4493|        
4494|        # 检查路径安全性
4495|        if not self._is_safe_path(path):
4496|            raise SecurityError(f"不安全的文件路径: {path}")
4497|        
4498|        # 执行文件操作
4499|        if operation == "read":
4500|            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
4501|                content = f.read()
4502|            return {"success": True, "content": content}
4503|        
4504|        elif operation == "write":
4505|            content = parameters.get("content", "")
4506|            with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
4507|                f.write(content)
4508|            return {"success": True}
4509|        
4510|        else:
4511|            raise ValueError(f"不支持的文件操作: {operation}")
4512|    
4513|    def _is_safe_path(self, path: str) -> bool:
4514|        """检查路径是否安全"""
4515|        # 防止路径遍历攻击
4516|        if ".." in path or path.startswith("/") or ":" in path:
4517|            return False
4518|        
4519|        # 限制访问特定目录
4520|        allowed_dirs = ["/tmp", "/var/tmp", "/home/user/data"]
4521|        for allowed_dir in allowed_dirs:
4522|            if path.startswith(allowed_dir):
4523|                return True
4524|        
4525|        return False
4526|    
4527|    async def _call_tool_function(self, tool_metadata: ToolMetadata, parameters: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
4528|        """调用工具函数"""
4529|        # 这里应该调用实际的工具函数
4530|        # 简化实现，返回模拟结果
4531|        return {
4532|            "success": True,
4533|            "result": f"执行工具 {tool_metadata.name} 成功",
4534|            "execution_time": 0.1
4535|        }
4536|    
4537|    def _log_audit(self, user_id: str, tool_id: str, parameters: Dict[str, Any], 
4538|                   action: str, result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, error: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
4539|        """记录审计日志"""
4540|        log_entry = {
4541|            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
4542|            "user_id": user_id,
4543|            "tool_id": tool_id,
4544|            "action": action,
4545|            "parameters": self._sanitize_parameters(parameters),
4546|            "result": result,
4547|            "error": error
4548|        }
4549|        
4550|        self._audit_log.append(log_entry)
4551|        
4552|        # 限制日志大小
4553|        if len(self._audit_log) > 1000:
4554|            self._audit_log = self._audit_log[-1000:]
4555|    
4556|    def _sanitize_parameters(self, parameters: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
4557|        """清理敏感参数"""
4558|        sanitized = {}
4559|        sensitive_keys = ["password", "token", "secret", "key", "credential"]
4560|        
4561|        for key, value in parameters.items():
4562|            if any(sensitive in key.lower() for sensitive in sensitive_keys):
4563|                sanitized[key] = "***REDACTED***"
4564|            else:
4565|                sanitized[key] = value
4566|        
4567|        return sanitized
4568|    
4569|    def get_audit_logs(self, limit: int = 100) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
4570|        """获取审计日志"""
4571|        return self._audit_log[-limit:]

4574|class SecurityMiddleware:
4575|    """安全中间件"""
4576|    
4577|    def __init__(self, security_manager: ToolSecurityManager):
4578|        self.security_manager = security_manager
4579|    
4580|    async def __call__(self, request: Dict[str, Any], call_next) -> Dict[str, Any]:
4581|        """中间件处理"""
4582|        # 1. 验证请求
4583|        if not self._validate_request(request):
4584|            return {"error": "无效请求", "success": False}
4585|        
4586|        # 2. 提取用户信息
4587|        user_id = request.get("user_id", "anonymous")
4588|        
4589|        # 3. 检查工具权限
4590|        tool_id = request.get("tool_id")
4591|        if not tool_id:
4592|            return {"error": "缺少工具ID", "success": False}
4593|        
4594|        # 4. 执行工具
4595|        try:
4596|            result = await self.security_manager.execute_tool_with_security(
4597|                user_id=user_id,
4598|                tool_id=tool_id,
4599|                tool_metadata=request.get("tool_metadata"),
4600|                parameters=request.get("parameters", {})
4601|            )
4602|            
4603|            # 5. 添加安全头
4604|            result["security_headers"] = {
4605|                "x-content-type-options": "nosniff",
4606|                "x-frame-options": "DENY",
4607|                "x-xss-protection": "1; mode=block"
4608|            }
4609|            
4610|            return result
4611|            
4612|        except PermissionError as e:
4613|            return {"error": str(e), "success": False, "code": "PERMISSION_DENIED"}
4614|        except SecurityError as e:
4615|            return {"error": str(e), "success": False, "code": "SECURITY_VIOLATION"}
4616|        except Exception as e:
4617|            return {"error": f"执行失败: {str(e)}", "success": False, "code": "EXECUTION_ERROR"}
4618|    
4619|    def _validate_request(self, request: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
4620|        """验证请求"""
4621|        required_fields = ["tool_id", "parameters"]
4622|        for field in required_fields:
4623|            if field not in request:
4624|                return False
4625|        
4626|        # 检查参数类型
4627|        if not isinstance(request["parameters"], dict):
4628|            return False
4629|        
4630|        return True

4633|# 8. 配置和部署方案
4634|
4635|## 8.1 配置文件结构
4636|
4637|```yaml
4638|# config/tools.yaml
4639|tools:
4640|  # 工具注册配置
4641|  registry:
4642|    auto_discover: true
4643|    discovery_paths:
4644|      - "backend/app/services/tools/"
4645|      - "plugins/"
4646|    scan_interval: 300  # 5分钟
4647|    
4648|  # 工具管理器配置
4649|  manager:
4650|    cache_enabled: true
4651|    cache_ttl: 3600  # 1小时
4652|    max_tools_per_user: 100
4653|    default_timeout: 30  # 秒
4654|    
4655|  # 权限配置
4656|  permissions:
4657|    enabled: true
4658|    default_role: "user"
4659|    roles:
4660|      admin:
4661|        permissions:
4662|          - "tool.*"
4663|          - "system.*"
4664|      user:
4665|        permissions:
4666|          - "tool.execute"
4667|          - "tool.read"
4668|      guest:
4669|        permissions:
4670|          - "tool.read"
4671|    
4672|  # 沙箱配置
4673|  sandbox:
4674|    enabled: true
4675|    memory_limit_mb: 512
4676|    cpu_limit_percent: 50
4677|    disk_limit_mb: 1024
4678|    network_enabled: false
4679|    read_only_filesystem: true
4680|    timeout_seconds: 30
4681|    
4682|  # 安全配置
4683|  security:
4684|    audit_logging: true
4685|    max_audit_logs: 1000
4686|    parameter_validation: true
4687|    sql_injection_check: true
4688|    command_injection_check: true
4689|    
4690|  # 工作流引擎配置
4691|  workflow:
4692|    max_parallel_tasks: 10
4693|    default_timeout: 300  # 5分钟
4694|    retry_policy:
4695|      max_retries: 3
4696|      backoff_factor: 2
4697|      initial_delay: 1  # 秒
4698|```

4700|## 8.2 环境配置
4701|
4702|```python
4703|# config/environment.py
4704|import os
4705|from enum import Enum
4706|
4707|class Environment(str, Enum):
4708|    DEVELOPMENT = "development"
4709|    TESTING = "testing"
4710|    STAGING = "staging"
4711|    PRODUCTION = "production"
4712|
4713|class ToolConfig:
4714|    """工具系统配置"""
4715|    
4716|    def __init__(self):
4717|        self.environment = os.getenv("ENVIRONMENT", Environment.DEVELOPMENT)
4718|        
4719|        # 工具注册配置
4720|        self.auto_discover = os.getenv("TOOLS_AUTO_DISCOVER", "true").lower() == "true"
4721|        self.discovery_paths = os.getenv("TOOLS_DISCOVERY_PATHS", "backend/app/services/tools/,plugins/").split(",")

5007|### 8.6.2 插件系统
5008|```python
5009|# plugins/custom_plugin/__init__.py
5010|from typing import List
5011|from app.services.tools.base import ToolMetadata, register_tool
5012|
5013|class CustomPlugin:
5014|    """自定义插件"""
5015|    
5016|    def __init__(self):
5017|        self.tools: List[ToolMetadata] = []
5018|    
5019|    def register_tools(self):
5020|        """注册插件中的工具"""
5021|        # 自动发现并注册工具
5022|        self._discover_tools()
5023|        
5024|    def _discover_tools(self):
5025|        """发现工具"""
5026|        # 扫描插件目录中的工具
5027|        import os
5028|        import importlib
5029|        
5030|        plugin_dir = os.path.dirname(__file__)
5031|        for filename in os.listdir(plugin_dir):
5032|            if filename.endswith("_tool.py"):
5033|                module_name = f"plugins.custom_plugin.{filename[:-3]}"
5034|                module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
5035|                
5036|                # 注册模块中的工具
5037|                if hasattr(module, "register"):
5038|                    module.register(self)
5039|```

5041|### 8.6.3 配置热重载
5042|```python
5043|class ConfigManager:
5044|    """配置管理器"""
5045|    
5046|    def __init__(self, config_path: str):
5047|        self.config_path = config_path
5048|        self.config = self._load_config()
5049|        self._last_modified = os.path.getmtime(config_path)
5050|        
5051|    def _load_config(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
5052|        """加载配置"""
5053|        with open(self.config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
5054|            return yaml.safe_load(f)
5055|    
5056|    def check_and_reload(self) -> bool:
5057|        """检查并重新加载配置"""
5058|        current_modified = os.path.getmtime(self.config_path)
5059|        if current_modified > self._last_modified:
5060|            self.config = self._load_config()
5061|            self._last_modified = current_modified
5062|            return True
5063|        return False
5064|    
5065|    def get(self, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
5066|        """获取配置值"""
5067|        keys = key.split('.')
5068|        value = self.config
5069|        
5070|        for k in keys:
5071|            if isinstance(value, dict) and k in value:
5072|                value = value[k]
5073|            else:
5074|                return default
5075|        
5076|        return value
5077|```

5079|## 8.7 性能优化建议
5080|
5081|### 8.7.1 缓存策略
5082|```python
5083|from functools import lru_cache
5084|import time
5085|
5086|class ToolCache:
5087|    """工具缓存"""
5088|    
5089|    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 1000, ttl: int = 3600):
5090|        self.cache = {}
5091|        self.max_size = max_size
5092|        self.ttl = ttl  # 秒
5093|    
5094|    @lru_cache(maxsize=100)
5095|    def get_tool(self, tool_id: str) -> Optional[ToolMetadata]:
5096|        """获取工具（带缓存）"""
5097|        if tool_id in self.cache:
5098|            cached_item = self.cache[tool_id]
5099|            if time.time() - cached_item["timestamp"] < self.ttl:
5100|                return cached_item["tool"]
5101|        
5102|        # 从数据库或文件加载
5103|        tool = self._load_tool(tool_id)
5104|        if tool:
5105|            self.cache[tool_id] = {
5106|                "tool": tool,
5107|                "timestamp": time.time()
5108|            }
5109|            # 清理过期缓存
5110|            self._cleanup_cache()
5111|        
5112|        return tool
5113|    
5114|    def _cleanup_cache(self):
5115|        """清理缓存"""
5116|        if len(self.cache) > self.max_size:
5117|            # 移除最旧的缓存项
5118|            sorted_items = sorted(self.cache.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["timestamp"])
5119|            for tool_id, _ in sorted_items[:len(self.cache) - self.max_size]:
5120|                del self.cache[tool_id]
5121|```
5122|
5123|### 8.7.2 异步执行优化
5124|```python
5125|import asyncio
5126|from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, ProcessPoolExecutor
5127|
5128|class AsyncExecutor:
5129|    """异步执行器"""
5130|    
5131|    def __init__(self, max_workers: int = 10):
5132|        self.thread_pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers)
5133|        self.process_pool = ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers)
5134|    
5135|    async def execute_io_bound(self, func, *args, **kwargs):
5136|        """执行I/O密集型任务"""
5137|        loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
5138|        return await loop.run_in_executor(
5139|            self.thread_pool,
5140|            lambda: func(*args, **kwargs)
5141|        )
5142|    
5143|    async def execute_cpu_bound(self, func, *args, **kwargs):
5144|        """执行CPU密集型任务"""
5145|        loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
5146|        return await loop.run_in_executor(
5147|            self.process_pool,
5148|            lambda: func(*args, **kwargs)
5149|        )
5150|```

5175|## 8.8 故障恢复和备份
5176|
5177|### 8.8.1 工具注册表备份
5178|```python
5179|import json
5180|from datetime import datetime
5181|
5182|class ToolRegistryBackup:
5183|    """工具注册表备份"""
5184|    
5185|    def __init__(self, registry: ToolRegistry, backup_dir: str = "backups"):
5186|        self.registry = registry
5187|        self.backup_dir = backup_dir
5188|        os.makedirs(backup_dir, exist_ok=True)
5189|    
5190|    def create_backup(self) -> str:
5191|        """创建备份"""
5192|        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
5193|        backup_file = os.path.join(self.backup_dir, f"tool_registry_{timestamp}.json")
5194|        
5195|        # 导出所有工具
5196|        tools_data = []
5197|        for tool_id, tool in self.registry._tools.items():
5198|            tools_data.append({
5199|                "id": tool_id,
5200|                "name": tool.name,
5201|                "display_name": tool.display_name,
5202|                "description": tool.description,
5203|                "type": tool.type.value,
5204|                "category": tool.category,
5205|                "capabilities": [c.value for c in tool.capabilities],
5206|                "permissions": [p.to_dict() for p in tool.permissions],
5207|                "requirements": tool.requirements.to_dict() if tool.requirements else None
5208|            })
5209|        
5210|        # 保存到文件
5211|        with open(backup_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
5212|            json.dump({
5213|                "timestamp": timestamp,
5214|                "tool_count": len(tools_data),
5215|                "tools": tools_data
5216|            }, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
5217|        
5218|        return backup_file
5219|    
5220|    def restore_backup(self, backup_file: str) -> bool:
5221|        """恢复备份"""
5222|        try:
5223|            with open(backup_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
5224|                backup_data = json.load(f)
5225|            
5226|            # 清空当前注册表
5227|            self.registry._tools.clear()
5228|            self.registry._name_index.clear()
5229|            self.registry._display_name_index.clear()
5230|            self.registry._categories.clear()
5231|            self.registry._types.clear()
5232|            self.registry._capabilities.clear()
5233|            
5234|            # 恢复工具
5235|            for tool_data in backup_data["tools"]:
5236|                tool = ToolMetadata(
5237|                    name=tool_data["name"],
5238|                    display_name=tool_data["display_name"],
5239|                    description=tool_data["description"],
5240|                    type=ToolType(tool_data["type"]),
5241|                    category=tool_data.get("category"),
5242|                    capabilities=[ToolCapability(c) for c in tool_data.get("capabilities", [])],
5243|                    permissions=[ToolPermission.from_dict(p) for p in tool_data.get("permissions", [])],
5244|                    requirements=ToolRequirements.from_dict(tool_data["requirements"]) if tool_data.get("requirements") else None
5245|                )
5246|                
5247|                self.registry.register(tool_data["id"], tool)
5248|            
5249|            return True
5250|            
5251|        except Exception as e:
5252|            print(f"恢复备份失败: {e}")
5253|            return False
5254|```

5256|### 8.8.2 监控和告警
5257|```python
5258|class MonitoringSystem:
5259|    """监控系统"""
5260|    
5261|    def __init__(self):
5262|        self.metrics = {}
5263|        self.alerts = []
5264|    
5265|    def record_metric(self, name: str, value: float, tags: Dict[str, str] = None):
5266|        """记录指标"""
5267|        if name not in self.metrics:
5268|            self.metrics[name] = []
5269|        
5270|        self.metrics[name].append({
5271|            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
5272|            "value": value,
5273|            "tags": tags or {}
5274|        })
5275|        
5276|        # 检查告警条件
5277|        self._check_alerts(name, value, tags)
5278|    
5279|    def add_alert(self, name: str, condition, message: str, severity: str = "warning"):
5280|        """添加告警规则"""
5281|        self.alerts.append({
5282|            "name": name,
5283|            "condition": condition,
5284|            "message": message,
5285|            "severity": severity
5286|        })
5287|    
5288|    def _check_alerts(self, metric_name: str, value: float, tags: Dict[str, str]):
5289|        """检查告警条件"""
5290|        for alert in self.alerts:
5291|            if alert["condition"](metric_name, value, tags):
5292|                self._trigger_alert(alert, value, tags)
5293|    
5294|    def _trigger_alert(self, alert: Dict[str, Any], value: float, tags: Dict[str, str]):
5295|        """触发告警"""
5296|        alert_message = f"[{alert['severity'].upper()}] {alert['message']}"
5297|        alert_message += f" - 当前值: {value}"
5298|        if tags:
5299|            alert_message += f" - 标签: {tags}"
5300|        
5301|        print(f"告警: {alert_message}")
5302|        
5303|        # 这里可以集成到邮件、Slack等通知系统
5304|        # self._send_notification(alert_message)
5305|```

5504|# 9. 总结
5505|
5506|## 9.1 设计优势
5507|
5508|1. **模块化架构**：系统采用分层设计，各模块职责清晰，便于维护和扩展
5509|2. **类型安全**：通过枚举和类型提示确保工具类型的类型安全
5510|3. **灵活扩展**：支持插件机制，可以轻松添加新的工具类型和功能
5511|4. **安全可控**：完整的权限控制和沙箱执行环境，确保系统安全
5512|5. **高性能**：支持异步执行和缓存机制，提高系统性能
5513|6. **易于部署**：提供完整的配置和部署方案，支持多种部署模式
5514|
5515|## 9.2 适用场景
5516|
5517|1. **企业级应用**：需要严格权限控制和审计日志的场景
5518|2. **多租户系统**：支持多用户、多角色的工具管理系统
5519|3. **自动化工作流**：复杂的工具组合和编排需求
5520|4. **安全敏感环境**：需要沙箱隔离和资源限制的场景
5521|5. **高可用系统**：需要分布式部署和故障恢复能力的系统
5522|
5523|## 9.3 未来扩展方向
5524|
5525|1. **AI集成**：集成AI模型作为工具类型，支持智能决策
5526|2. **可视化编排**：提供图形化的工作流编排界面
5527|3. **移动端支持**：开发移动端应用，支持移动设备访问
5528|4. **云原生部署**：支持Kubernetes和云原生部署
5529|5. **多语言支持**：支持多种编程语言的工具开发
5530|

  12|## 一、问题概述
  13|
  14|### 1.1 性能问题背景
  15|
  16|根据北京老陈反馈，前端页面存在以下三个性能问题：
  17|
  18|| 序号 | 问题 | 具体现象 | 严重程度 |
  19||------|------|----------|----------|
  20|| **问题1** | **启动加载慢** | 浏览器打开后出现**短时间完全空白**（什么都看不到），然后才突然出现页面框架、左侧菜单、头部标题 | 高 |
  21|| **问题2** | **标题编辑无反应** | 点击会话标题后**没有任何反应**，无法进入编辑状态修改会话标题 | 中 |
  22|| **问题3** | **消息显示慢** | 输入新消息发送后，**用户消息气泡**需要**约0.5秒以上**才显示，**AI消息气泡**需要**1秒以上**才显示 | 高 |
  23|
  24|**最近会话示例**：4月9日 下午会话 15:53
  25|
  26|### 1.2 三个问题的关系分析
  27|
  28|| 问题 | 根因 | 与其他问题的关系 |
  29||------|------|------------------|
  30|| **问题1：启动加载慢** | 缺少骨架屏、bundle加载慢、React初始化 | 独立的首屏渲染问题 |
  31|| **问题2：标题编辑无反应** | catch块错误处理后未重置editingTitle状态 | 独立的事件处理问题 |
  32|| **问题3：消息显示慢** | SSE回调频繁setMessages + sessionStorage阻塞 | 独立的状态更新问题 |
  33|
  34|**总结**：三个问题**相对独立**，但都与"渲染性能"相关：
  35|- 问题1：页面初始渲染（首屏）
  36|- 问题2：交互响应（事件处理）
  37|- 问题3：状态更新渲染（运行时）

  57|
  58|## 二、问题2：标题编辑无反应深度分析
  59|
  60|### 2.1 问题表现
  61|
  62|用户点击会话标题后，**没有任何反应**，无法进入编辑状态修改会话标题。
  63|
  64|### 2.2 代码问题点分析
  65|
  66|#### 2.2.1 点击事件绑定位置错误（第2188-2197行）
  67|
  68|**问题代码**：
  69|
  70|```typescript
  71|// 第2188-2197行 - 原代码
  72|<Space>
  73|  <RobotOutlined />
  74|  <span>AI对话助手</span>
  75|  {isReceiving && <Badge status="processing" text="接收中..." />}
  76|  {sessionId && (editingTitle ? (
  77|    // 编辑状态的Input
  78|  ) : (
  79|    <span
  80|      style={{
  81|        cursor: "pointer",
  82|        // ... 样式
  83|      }}
  84|      onClick={() => setEditingTitle(true)}  // ← 点击事件只在span上
  85|    >
  86|      {sessionTitle || "未命名会话"}
  87|    </span>
  88|  ))}
  89|</Space>
  90|```
  91|
  92|**问题说明**：
  93|1. 点击事件`onClick`只绑定了内部的span（第2195行），这个span没有padding
  94|2. Ant Design的Card组件会对title属性进行包装处理，导致点击事件无法正常传递
  95|3. 点击区域非常小，用户很难点击到文字部分
  96|
  97|#### 2.2.2 sessionId条件导致的问题
  98|
  99|**问题代码**：
 100|
 101|```typescript
 102|// 第2102行
 103|{sessionId && (editingTitle ? (...) : (...))}
 104|```
 105|
 106|**问题说明**：
 107|- 当sessionId为null时，整个标题区域（包括点击元素）不会被渲染
 108|- 但这个问题与"点击无反应"不是同一个问题
 109|
 110|### 2.3 标题编辑无反应问题根因总结
 111|
 112|| 根因 | 位置 | 影响程度 | 优先级 |
 113||------|------|----------|--------|
 114|| **点击事件绑定在内部span，区域太小** | 第2195行 | 高 | P0 |
 115|| **Card的title属性处理后点击事件被拦截** | 第2097行 | 高 | P0 |
 116|| **sessionId为null时不显示标题** | 第2102行 | 中 | P1 |
 117|
 118|### 2.4 优化方案
 119|
 120|#### 2.4.1 将onClick绑定到外层Space（第2098行）
 121|
 122|```typescript
 123|// 修复后的代码
 124|title={
 125|  <Space 
 126|    onClick={() => setEditingTitle(true)}  // ← 绑定在外层Space
 127|    style={{ cursor: "pointer", width: "100%" }}
 128|  >
 129|    <RobotOutlined />
 130|    <span>AI对话助手</span>
 131|    {isReceiving && <Badge status="processing" text="接收中..." />}
 132|    {sessionId && editingTitle ? (  // ← 简化条件
 133|      // 编辑状态
 134|    ) : (
 135|      // 显示状态
 136|    )}
 137|  </Space>
 138|}
 139|```
 140|
 141|**优化效果**：
 142|- 点击整个标题区域都能触发编辑状态
 143|- 不受Ant Design Card组件的title处理影响
 144|- 保留sessionId条件，只影响编辑状态显示，不影响点击区域
 145|
 146|#### 2.4.2 修复验证
 147|
 148|- ✅ 点击标题区域，鼠标变成小手样式
 149|- ✅ 点击后进入编辑状态，显示Input输入框
 150|- ✅ 保留sessionId条件逻辑
 151|

 155|  if (titleInput.trim() && sessionId) {

 173|**可能的问题**：
 174|
 175|1. **异步执行导致的状态问题**：onBlur是异步的，在setEditingTitle(false)执行前，可能有其他逻辑触发了setEditingTitle(true)
 176|2. **竞态条件**：如果用户快速操作（编辑→回车→blur），可能导致状态混乱
 177|
 178|### 2.3 标题编辑无反应问题根因总结
 179|
 180|| 根因 | 位置 | 影响程度 | 优先级 |
 181||------|------|----------|--------|
 182|| 错误处理后状态未正确重置 | 第2091-2127行 | 中 | P1 |
 183|| sessionId可能为null导致条件不满足 | 第2093行 | 中 | P1 |
 184|| 异步操作的竞态条件 | - | 低 | P2 |
 185|
 186|### 2.4 优化方案
 187|
 188|#### 2.4.1 使用finally确保状态重置
 189|
 190|```typescript
 191|onPressEnter={async (e) => {
 192|  e.preventDefault();
 193|  
 194|  // 保护：确保sessionId存在
 195|  if (!sessionId) {
 196|    setEditingTitle(false);
 197|    return;
 198|  }
 199|  
 200|  const trimmedTitle = titleInput.trim();
 201|  if (!trimmedTitle) {
 202|    setEditingTitle(false);
 203|    return;
 204|  }
 205|  
 206|  try {
 207|    await sessionApi.updateSession(sessionId, trimmedTitle, sessionVersion);
 208|    setSessionTitle(trimmedTitle);
 209|    setTitleLocked(true);
 210|    showTitleSaved();
 211|  } catch (error: any) {
 212|    if (error?.response?.status === 409) {
 213|      showSessionConflict();
 214|      // 同步获取最新数据
 215|    } else {
 216|      console.warn("保存标题失败:", error);
 217|      showSaveError("保存标题失败，请重试");
 218|    }
 219|  } finally {
 220|    // ⭐ 确保无论成功失败都会退出编辑状态
 221|    setEditingTitle(false);
 222|  }
 223|}}
 224|```

 228|## 三、问题3：消息显示慢深度分析（发送消息后气泡显示延迟）
 229|
 230|> **详细分析见第七章**
 231|
 232|### 3.1 问题表现
 233|
 234|- **用户消息气泡**：需要约0.5秒以上才显示
 235|- **AI消息气泡**：需要1秒以上才显示
 236|
 237|### 3.2 根因概要
 238|
 239|| 根因 | 位置 | 影响程度 | 优先级 |
 240||------|------|----------|--------|
 241|| SSE回调频繁调用setMessages | NewChatContainer.tsx 第198-349行 | 高 | P0 |
 242|| sessionStorage频繁序列化阻塞 | NewChatContainer.tsx 第705-747行 | 高 | P0 |
 243|| scrollToBottom频繁执行 | NewChatContainer.tsx 第694行 | 中 | P1 |
 244|
 245|### 3.3 优化方案概要
 246|
 247|1. **Ref累积更新**：使用ref存储临时内容，减少setMessages调用频率
 248|2. **debounce保存**：500ms防抖延迟sessionStorage保存
 249|3. **throttle滚动**：200ms节流控制scrollToBottom执行
 250|
 251|### 3.4 详细方案
 252|
 253|详见 **第七章：问题3消息显示慢深度分析和优化方案**，包含：
 254|- 详细的代码问题点分析
 255|- 完整的优化代码示例
 256|- 实施检查清单
 257|- 优化效果预期
 258|
